title: AutoXRD: Autonomous LLM Agents and Comprehensive Evaluation for Powder Diffraction Analysis
summary: Powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) is central to materials characterization, yet reliable end-to-end automation remains challenging. An XRD agent must interpret diffraction evidence, operate refinement software, manage coupled parameters in a defensible order, and distinguish numerical improvement from physical validity. In this paper, we propose AutoXRD, an autonomous large language model (LLM) agent framework that organizes powder-XRD analysis as stepwise refinement, grounds actions in observed evidence, and applies deterministic crystallographic and physical checks before accepting results. We further introduce XRDBench with two complementary tracks. XRDBench-QA contains 100 bounded diagnostic tasks that isolate scientific reasoning and decision-making, whereas XRDBench-E2E contains 34 executable workflows that test whether agents can compose these capabilities into complete analyses requiring file inspection, crystallographic-software execution, iterative refinement, evidence preservation, and reporting. We evaluate ten recent LLMs across 1,340 model--task runs. Models average only 57.8 out of 100, falling from 61.9 on XRDBench-QA to 53.7 on XRDBench-E2E. They perform best on refinement-history assessment and result acceptance, but remain substantially weaker on refinement-action selection, phase quantification, indexing, and Rietveld refinement. GPT-5.6 Sol achieves the highest overall score of 81.1, GPT-5.6 Terra the highest XRDBench-E2E point estimate of 81.0, and GPT-5.6 Luna the best score--cost trade-off. Ablations show that all six AutoXRD components consistently improve performance, supporting the framework design. Finally, execution-trace analysis reveals recurring failures in coupled-parameter control, quantitative reasoning, evidence preservation, and workflow termination, motivating stronger scientific constraints, uncertainty-aware decisions, and more efficient planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoXRD，一个自主LLM智能体框架，用于粉末X射线衍射(XRD)分析的端到端自动化，并引入XRDBench基准（含QA和E2E两个轨道）来系统评估LLM在XRD分析中的能力。评估10个近期LLM共1340次运行，平均得分仅57.8/100，揭示模型在耦合参数控制、定量推理等方面存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 粉末XRD分析是材料表征的核心工具，但可靠的端到端自动化仍然具有挑战性。XRD智能体需要解释衍射证据、操作精修软件、按可辩护顺序管理耦合参数，并区分数值改进与物理有效性，这些复杂要求使得传统方法难以胜任，亟需系统化的智能体框架和评估基准。
AI.method: 提出AutoXRD框架，将粉末XRD分析组织为逐步精修过程，基于可观察证据进行行动决策，并采用确定性晶体学和物理检查来验证结果。同时引入XRDBench基准，包含XRDBench-QA（100个有界诊断任务，测试科学推理和决策能力）和XRDBench-E2E（34个可执行工作流，测试完整分析能力，涵盖文件检查、软件执行、迭代精修、证据保存和报告）两个互补轨道。
AI.result: 评估10个LLM共1340次运行，模型平均得分57.8/100（QA轨道61.9降至E2E轨道53.7）。模型在精修历史评估和结果接受方面表现最佳，但在精修行动选择、相位定量、指标化指数和Rietveld精修方面较弱。GPT-5.6 Sol总得分最高(81.1)，GPT-5.6 Terra在E2E轨道最高(81.0)，GPT-5.6 Luna性价比最佳。消融实验证实AutoXRD所有六个组件均能一致提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 执行轨迹分析揭示了模型在耦合参数控制、定量推理、证据保存和工作流终止方面的反复失败，这激励了更强的科学约束、不确定性感知决策和更高效的规划需求的提出，为未来XRD自动化智能体的改进指明了方向。

title: Fermi-Level Metal-d Character of Group-6 Bis-Hexahapto Bilayer Graphene
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures. DFT study of bis-hexahapto group-6 bilayer graphene; electron-phonon coupling not computed
summary: Superconductivity in graphite intercalation compounds requires occupancy of a carbon-derived interlayer band filled by charge from an electropositive intercalant. Bis-hexahapto (eta6-eta6) coordination binds transition metals covalently to two graphene sheets with little charge transfer -- the mechanism that defines this chemistry removes the donation on which intercalated-graphite superconductivity rests. We ask, for group-6 Cr, Mo and W in bilayer graphene, whether Fermi-level states retain the interstitial, carbon-p character of ionic references, with bulk CaC6 and same-cell C12Ca/C12Li controls. Electron-phonon coupling is not computed. At one metal per gallery (C12M), the ionic controls retain 68 and 45 per cent, respectively, of gallery spectral weight in atom-masked interstitial regions at EF; the group-6 systems retain 15, 22 and 23 per cent. The contrast is compositional: group-6 galleries carry more absolute interstitial weight than C12Li, but projected density of states within +/-0.15 eV of EF is carbon p dominated in the ionic references and metal d dominated (~73 per cent) in all three group-6 bilayers. Every system studied is metallic; they differ in what carries the Fermi surface. Geometrically, eta6-eta6 coordination requires AA stacking and reverses the intrinsic Bernal preference by 400-600 meV wherever metal is present. Ordered phases are metastable against bulk metal (+2.9-5.0 eV per atom) but bound against isolated atoms (-1.6-4.1 eV); instability ordering (Cr least, W most) matches Cr > Mo > W reactivity. C12Cr is metallic; tungsten alone carries 0.65 muB. Bis-hexahapto intercalation delivers strong interlayer bonding and a definite AA registry, but not the interlayer-band character associated with superconducting graphite intercalation compounds.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过第一性原理计算，探讨双层石墨烯中双六配位(eta6-eta6)过渡金属(Cr、Mo、W)插层的电子结构特性，发现这类系统虽保持金属性和强层间键合，但费米面以金属d态为主而非离子型插层石墨化合物中的碳夹层带特征，因此不具备超导插层石墨的关键电子结构前提。
AI.motivation: 石墨插层化合物的超导性依赖于电正性插层剂向碳衍生夹层带提供电荷。然而，双六配位(eta6-eta6)共价配位使过渡金属与双层石墨烯共价结合，电荷转移极少——这种化学机制恰好消除了插层石墨超导所需的电子捐献。研究者希望弄清这种体系的费米能级态是否仍保留夹层碳p特征的离子型参考态。
AI.method: 对双层石墨烯中第6族过渡金属(Cr、Mo、W)进行第一性原理计算，不计算电子-声子耦合。以体相CaC6和同胞C12Ca/C12Li作为离子型对照。分析原子屏蔽夹层区域的谱权重、费米能级±0.15 eV内的投影态密度(区分碳p和金属d贡献)、堆积方式能量差异、以及各种金属的稳定性与磁性。
AI.result: 一个金属对应一个通道(C12M)时，离子型对照在EF处保留68%(Ca)和45%(Li)的夹层谱权重，而第6族体系仅保留15%、22%和23%。虽然第6族夹层绝对间隙权重高于C12Li，但EF±0.15 eV内投影态密度表明：离子型参考以碳p为主，三个第6族双层均以金属d为主(~73%)。所有体系均呈现金属性，区别在于费米面载体。几何上eta6-eta6要求AA堆垛且使本征Bernal偏好反转400-600 meV。有序相对体相金属亚稳(+2.9-5.0 eV/原子)，但对孤立原子束缚(-1.6-4.1 eV)；不稳定性排序(Cr最稳定，W最不稳定)与Cr > Mo > W反应活性一致。C12Cr呈金属性；W单独携带0.65 μB磁矩。
AI.conclusion: 双六配位插层能提供强层间键合和确定的AA堆垛序，但不具备与超导石墨插层化合物相关的夹层带电子结构特征。这类材料与超导GIC的关键区别在于费米面由金属d态而非碳p夹层态承载，因此不支持超导性机制所依赖的电子结构前提。

title: Magnetic frustration and non-collinear textures in layered Gd magnets
summary: Using scale-bridging simulations based on electronic structure theory and atomistic spin dynamics, we investigate the magnetic properties of skyrmionic GdRu$_2$Si$_2$ and GdRu$_2$Ge$_2$ layered rare-earth magnets and similar Gd-based compounds (GdAu$_2$Si$_2$, GdAu$_2$Ge$_2$, GdAg$_2$Si$_2$ and GdAg$_2$Ge$_2$). By studying the trends across this structural family, we confirm the importance of magnetic frustration and dipolar interactions for the stability of non-collinear and skyrmion phases. Furthermore, our calculations predict promising opportunities for chemical tuning of these magnets in terms of the balance between various exchange interactions and the character of the magnetic anisotropy. These changes lead to the formation of new types of skyrmions that are stable in a wide range of applied external magnetic field. In particular, we propose partial alkali-metal substitution of Gd in GdRu$_2$Si$_2$ leading to GdKRu$_4$Si$_4$, GdRbRu$_4$Si$_4$, GdCsRu$_4$Si$_4$ as well as GdYRu$_4$Si$_4$ compounds, and suggest that it is likely to result in an ordered layered structure, similarly to previously reported iron pnictides like CaKFe$_4$As$_4$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过电子结构理论和原子自旋动力学的跨尺度模拟，系统研究了基于Gd的层状稀土磁体（GdRu₂Si₂、GdRu₂Ge₂及相关化合物）中的斯格明子磁性。研究发现磁性阻挫和偶极相互作用对非共线磁序和斯格明子相稳定性至关重要，并预测通过化学调谐可调控交换相互作用和磁各向异性的平衡。特别提出碱金属部分取代Gd的方案（如GdKRu₄Si₄等），有望获得类似铁砷化物CaKFe₄As₄的有序层状结构，并在宽磁场范围内形成新型稳定斯格明子。
AI.motivation: 探索层状稀土磁体中斯格明子相的稳定机制，并寻找通过化学掺杂调控磁性、实现新型稳定斯格明子材料的途径。
AI.method: 采用基于电子结构理论和原子自旋动力学的跨尺度（scale-bridging）模拟方法，对GdRu₂Si₂、GdRu₂Ge₂及GdAu₂Si₂、GdAu₂Ge₂、GdAg₂Si₂、GdAg₂Ge₂等结构家族化合物进行系统对比研究，考察交换相互作用、磁各向异性和阻挫效应对磁性能的影响。
AI.result: 证实了磁性阻挫和偶极相互作用对斯格明子相稳定性的重要性；预测化学调谐能够改变各种交换相互作用之间的平衡和磁各向异性特征；提出碱金属原子部分取代Gd可获得GdKRu₄Si₄、GdRbRu₄Si₄、GdCsRu₄Si₄及GdYRu₄Si₄等新型有序层状结构化合物，并可在宽外磁场范围内形成新的稳定斯格明子相。
AI.conclusion: 化学取代是调控这类层状稀土磁体磁性并实现宽磁场范围内稳定新型斯格明子的有效策略，该结构家族为斯格明子材料的设计提供了广阔空间。

title: Size-Dependent Growth Rates Amplify Infinitesimal Asymmetry in Nanocrystals
summary: The kinetic Wulff construction predicts symmetric nonequilibrium shapes when crystallographically equivalent facets share a fixed growth rate. However, nanocrystals grow through finite facets whose nucleation barriers and ligand coverages depend on facet size. Here we develop a size-dependent kinetic construction and show that as a consequence infinitesimal seed asymmetries can be amplified into strongly asymmetric nanocrystal morphologies even when all symmetry-related facets obey the same microscopic growth law. Spatially heterogeneous nucleation rates and boundary limited growth generate facet growth velocities that depend on size, and deterministic shape evolution translates these local rates into global shape symmetry breaking. We illustrate the mechanism of persistent anisotropic growth on square and triangular lattices in two dimensions and on FCC seeds in three dimensions, where cuboctahedra can evolve toward rods or tetrahedra depending on which facet-area perturbations are amplified.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种尺寸依赖的动力学构建方法，发现在有限晶面的纳米晶生长过程中，即使在所有对称相关晶面遵循相同微观生长定律的条件下，微小的种子不对称性也能被放大为强烈不对称的纳米晶形貌。二维方形/三角形晶格和三维FCC种子的模拟表明，空间异质的成核速率和边界受限生长会导致晶面生长速度依赖尺寸，从而打破全局形状对称性。
AI.motivation: 经典Wulff动力学构建预测晶学等价晶面共享固定生长速率时会产生对称的非平衡形状。然而实际纳米晶生长涉及有限尺寸晶面，其成核势垒和配体覆盖度依赖于晶面大小，现有理论无法解释实验观察到的对称性破缺现象。
AI.method: 发展了一种尺寸依赖的动力学Wulff构建方法，将晶面尺寸相关的成核速率和边界受限生长效应纳入模型，通过确定性形状演化方程将局部晶面生长速率转化为全局形貌演变，并在二维方形/三角形晶格及三维FCC晶格上进行模拟验证。
AI.result: 证明了即便所有对称相关晶面遵循相同微观生长规律，微小种子不对称性仍可被放大为显著不对称的纳米晶形貌。在三维FCC种子中，立方八面体可依据不同晶面面积扰动的放大情况分别演化为棒状或四面体形貌。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了晶面尺寸依赖性这一隐蔽因素可导致纳米晶生长中全局对称性自发破缺，为理解和控制非对称纳米晶形貌提供了新的理论框架，对定向合成各向异性纳米材料具有指导意义。

title: Green-function Zeros Encode Competing Mott and Charge-ordering Scales
summary: While correlated insulators are devoid of low-energy quasiparticle poles, their Green functions retain clean momentum structure through zeros. However, precisely what zeros imply is not clear. By studying the extended Hubbard model both analytically and numerically, we establish a new paradigm for strongly correlated matter: the dispersion of Green function zeros is determined by both microscopic spin-spin correlations and defect kinematics. In fact, we find that the dispersion changes discontinuously across the transition between the Mott and the checkerboard charge-density wave phases as is expected for a first-order transition. This physics is robust to the inclusion of further neighbor hopping which simply fine tunes the spin-correlation or charge-defect kinematics. We conclude that it is the {\it dispersion} of the Green-function zeros that encode the physics of ordering resultant from the strong correlations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过解析和数值方法研究扩展Hubbard模型，建立了强关联物质的新范式：格林函数零点的色散由微观自旋-自旋关联和缺陷运动学共同决定，且在Mott绝缘体与棋盘电荷密度波相之间的一级相变处发生不连续变化。
AI.motivation: 关联绝缘体虽然缺乏低能准粒子极点，但其格林函数通过零点保留了清晰的动量结构。然而，零点究竟蕴含什么物理意义尚不明确，因此需要深入探究格林函数零点的精确含义。
AI.method: 对扩展Hubbard模型同时进行解析分析和数值计算，考察格林函数零点的色散行为及其与自旋关联、缺陷运动学的联系；并引入更远程的跳跃项验证物理的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 发现格林函数零点的色散由微观自旋-自旋关联和缺陷运动学共同决定；在Mott绝缘体与棋盘电荷密度波相之间的一级相变处，色散发生不连续跳变；该物理对更远程跳跃的引入保持鲁棒，后者仅微调自旋关联或电荷缺陷运动学。
AI.conclusion: 格林函数零点的色散编码了强关联所致有序态的物理，这一发现为理解强关联物质提供了新的理论范式。

title: Smoothed truncated Coulomb potential for periodic Gaussian-basis Hartree--Fock exchange
summary: Truncated Coulomb (TC) potentials reduce finite-size errors and accelerate thermodynamic-limit convergence in periodic Hartree--Fock (HF) calculations, but their use with Gaussian basis sets is complicated by the evaluation of electron repulsion integrals (ERIs), particularly for nonspherical truncation domains and all-electron calculations. We introduce the smoothed truncated Coulomb (sTC) potential as a systematically improvable approximation to a parent TC potential. A real-space Gaussian convolution smooths the sharp truncation boundary, and a single dimensionless parameter, $η$, controls the width of the smoothing window, which can be tightened to systematically approach the TC reference. The smoothing by sTC enables a dual-space algorithm for evaluating periodic Gaussian-basis ERIs that requires neither a large plane-wave basis nor new molecular integral kernels and is applicable to both pseudopotential and all-electron calculations, including the important Wigner--Seitz-cell truncation boundaries. Benchmarks spanning insulating, semiconducting, layered, metallic, and molecular-crystal systems show that sTC-based HF closely reproduces TC results in pseudopotential calculations and extends TC-quality calculations to all-electron settings. Across these systems, sTC substantially improves thermodynamic-limit convergence relative to the probe-charge Ewald method while remaining practical for all-electron calculations in which direct TC-based calculations are computationally challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种平滑截断库仑（sTC）势，通过对截断边界做高斯卷积平滑，以单一无量纲参数η控制平滑窗宽度，从而系统逼近TC参考。sTC支持双空间算法计算周期性高斯基组ERI，无需大平面波基组或新分子积分核，适用于赝势和全电子计算（含Wigner-Seitz胞截断），并在绝缘体、半导体、层状、金属及分子晶体体系中验证了其热力学极限收敛性和实用性。
AI.motivation: TC势能减少有限尺寸误差并加速周期性Hartree-Fock计算的热力学极限收敛，但结合高斯基组时，特别是在非球形截断域和全电子计算中，电子排斥积分（ERI）的评估非常复杂，是阻碍其广泛应用的瓶颈。
AI.method: 引入sTC势——通过实空间高斯卷积平滑TC的尖锐截断边界，用单一参数η控制平滑窗口宽度并系统逼近TC。该平滑特性使得一种双空间算法能够高效评估周期性高斯基组ERI，既不需要大型平面波基组，也无需新的分子积分内核，同时兼容赝势和全电子计算。
AI.result: 在绝缘体、半导体、层状、金属和分子晶体等多种体系中，sTC-HF在赝势计算中紧密复现TC结果，并将TC质量的计算扩展至全电子场景。相比探针电荷Ewald方法，sTC显著改善热力学极限收敛，且在直接TC计算困难的全电子体系中仍保持实用性。
AI.conclusion: sTC势作为TC势的可系统改进近似，兼具TC的收敛优势与更宽的适用性（含全电子计算），为周期性HF计算中的有限尺寸误差消除提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Bayesian Tracking of a Diffusing Target in Two and Three Dimensions
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 14 pages of supplemental material
summary: We study Bayesian tracking of a diffusing target monitored by a noisy distributed sensor array. Building on an earlier mapping to KPZ growth with a moving defect (or an equivalent directed polymer pinning problem) we determine the phase structure, beyond the previously-studied one-dimensional case, for both Bayes-optimal and suboptimal inference. In $d=2$, theoretical analysis and numerical simulations both give a depinning transition between a successful tracking phase and a failure phase. Weak-coupling RG shows that Bayes-optimal tracking is always successful in $d=2$, but failure can arise from overconfident (suboptimal) inference. In $d=3$, tracking can succeed, or can fail in two distinct ways: the posterior probability distribution may delocalize (no detection), or may become sharply localized, but at the wrong position (a false detection). The two possibilities correspond to Edwards-Wilkinson or Kardar-Parisi-Zhang statistics for the log-posterior. The three phases meet at a Nishimori-like multicritical point on a Bayes-optimal line in a two-parameter phase diagram. (Model misspecification alone can drive depinning into either unpinned phase: underconfidence gives diffuse failure, while overconfidence gives localized-but-wrong failure.) We analyze the transitions between the various phases numerically and with renormalization group arguments. We show that some of these have unusual critical behavior, which the conventional $ε$ expansion fails to describe. Recent rigorous results for directed polymers indicate an alternative scenario. Many of our results, including a scaling relation for exponents at pinning transitions and results for RG flows, are relevant to other phase transitions that involve surface growth or directed polymers in 2+1D or 3+1D.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究噪声分布式传感器阵列监视下扩散目标的贝叶斯跟踪问题，将其映射为KPZ生长/有向聚合物钉扎问题，确定了d=2和d=3维度下贝叶斯最优与次优推断的相结构，发现去钉扎转变、三种不同相位（成功跟踪、弥散失败、错误定位失败）以及Nishimori-like多临界点。
AI.motivation: 此前研究仅局限于一维情况，本文旨在将该贝叶斯跟踪问题推广到更高维度（d=2和d=3），理解空间维度对跟踪相变行为的影响，并区分贝叶斯最优推断与次优（如过度自信）推断导致的失败模式差异。
AI.method: 通过将贝叶斯跟踪问题映射到KPZ生长（带移动缺陷）或等价的有向聚合物钉扎问题，结合弱耦合重整化群（RG）分析、数值模拟、ε展开以及与有向聚合物的近期严格结果对比，分析各相及相变行为。
AI.result: 在d=2中，理论分析与模拟均显示存在去钉扎转变；Bayes最优跟踪总是成功，但过度自信的次优推断会导致失败。在d=3中，存在三种相位：成功跟踪、后验分布弥散（无检测）、以及后验尖锐局域化但在错误位置（错误检测）。三个相位在Bayes最优线上交汇于Nishimori-like多临界点。模型误设可驱动去钉扎进入任一未钉扎相。部分相变表现出反常临界行为，传统ε展开无法描述。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为高维分布式传感器阵列中扩散目标的贝叶斯跟踪提供了完整的相图理解，揭示了最优与次优推断的根本差异，且其定标关系和RG流结果对2+1D和3+1D表面生长及有向聚合物的其他相变具有普适意义。

title: Subgap Bound States from Dynamical Impurities
comment: Main document: 7 pages, 6 Figures. Supplement: 13 pages, 3 Figures
summary: We find that a single non-magnetic dynamical impurity (e.g., a low-frequency localized "vibron" mode) induces a subgap bound state in an s-wave superconductor. A closed-form solution for the bound state energy is found as a function of the vibron frequency in the elastic scattering limit, with the salient features of the bound state energies unaffected by inelastic scattering processes in the sub-THz regime. In addition to subgap features in the low-frequency local density of states, such impurities result in real space regions of reduced spectroscopic weight outside the gap peak.

AI.tldr: 本文发现单个非磁性动力学杂质（如低频局域振动模式）能在s波超导体中诱导出亚隙束缚态，并给出了弹性散射极限下束缚态能量与振动频率关系的闭式解。
AI.motivation: 研究非磁性杂质（特别是动力学振动模式）对超导体的影响，探索其在s波超导体中产生亚隙束缚态的物理机制，因为传统认识认为只有磁性杂质才能在s波超导体中产生亚隙态。这有助于理解超导体中非磁性无序和局部振动模式引起的光谱特征。
AI.method: 通过理论分析研究单个非磁性动力学杂质（低频局域振动模式）在s波超导体中的作用，在弹性散射极限下推导出束缚态能量的闭式解，并分析非弹性散射（亚太赫兹频段）对结果的影响，同时计算低频局域态密度和实空间谱权重分布。
AI.result: 发现了非磁性动力学杂质诱导的亚隙束缚态，获得了束缚态能量与振动频率的闭式解；在亚太赫兹频段，非弹性散射过程不会影响束缚态能量的主要特征；此外，这类杂质在低频局域态密度中产生亚隙特征，并在超导隙峰外的实空间区域造成谱权重减少。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究揭示了非磁性动力学杂质（振动模式）作为s波超导体中亚隙束缚态的新来源，为理解超导体中与局部振动相关的低频光谱特征和实空间谱权重分布提供了理论框架，对扫描隧道显微镜实验观测具有指导意义。

title: How Landau caterpillars turn into Hofstadter butterflies by tuning the periodic potential strength
summary: It is well-known that the spectrum of two-dimensional electrons in a perpendicular magnetic field is given by discrete flat Landau levels. By contrast, electrons in a two-dimensional tight-binding model give rise to a fractal Hofstadter butterfly spectrum. In this paper, we connect these two opposite limits by showing how a butterfly spectrum emerges from broadened Landau `caterpillars', by continuously increasing the periodic potential strength. We identify a series of topological transitions that isolate a lowest trivial band, a necessary condition for the butterfly to emerge. The resulting butterfly is topologically distinct from the Hofstadter butterfly at fluxes $φ>1$, due to anomalous behavior of diagonal hopping. Moreover, the hopping parameters of an effective tight-binding model, obtained by a Wannierization procedure at large magnetic field, are highly dependent on the flux, revealing that Wannier orbitals themselves change under the applied magnetic field. Our methods and results are relevant for artificial materials, such as moiré systems, where a full quantum of flux per lattice unit cell is experimentally accessible. On a theoretical level, having Wannierization methods for each specific flux allows more accurate many-body calculations in large magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 本文通过连续增加周期性势场强度，展示了朗道能级（"毛虫"）如何展宽并演化为分形的Hofstadter蝴蝶谱，实现了从平坦朗道能级到分形蝴蝶谱两个极限之间的连接。作者识别了一系列拓扑转变，分离出最低的平凡带作为蝴蝶谱出现的必要条件，并发现所得蝴蝶谱在通量φ>1时与标准Hofstadter蝴蝶谱具有拓扑差异（源于对角跳跃的反常行为）。此外，通过在大磁场下进行Wannier化得到的有效紧束缚模型跳跃参数高度依赖于通量，表明Wannier轨道本身会随外加磁场发生变化。
AI.motivation: 二维电子在垂直磁场中的朗道能级是离散平坦的，而二维紧束缚模型产生分形的Hofstadter蝴蝶谱。这两个极端极限之间的关系尚不清楚，作者希望连接这两个相反的极限，理解蝴蝶谱如何从朗道能级中涌现，并为moire系统等人工材料中的大磁场多体计算提供更精确的理论工具。
AI.method: 作者通过连续增加周期性势场强度，观察朗道能级如何展宽并形成蝴蝶谱。他们追踪拓扑转变的序列以隔离最低的平凡带，并使用Wannier化程序在大磁场下提取有效的紧束缚模型，研究跳跃参数对通量的依赖关系。
AI.result: 作者成功展示了从朗道能级到Hofstadter蝴蝶谱的涌现过程，识别了隔离最低平凡带所需的拓扑转变序列。发现所得蝴蝶谱在φ>1时与标准Hofstadter蝴蝶谱存在拓扑差异，这种差异源于对角跳跃的反常行为。Wannier化得到的紧束缚模型跳跃参数强烈依赖于通量，揭示了磁场对Wannier轨道本身的显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了朗道能级与Hofstadter蝴蝶谱之间的统一图景，对moire系统等人工材料（其中每晶胞可实验达到一个通量量子）具有实际意义；理论上，针对每个特定通量的Wannier化方法将使得大磁场下的多体计算更加精确。

title: Mixture of Polyconvex Neural Potentials for Parametric Hyperelasticity: Towards Foundation Material Models
summary: Hyperelastic constitutive models enable modeling large deformations in elastic solids. In common practice, a strain energy density function is prescribed in advance and model-specific parameters are calibrated from experiments. However, many applications require constitutive models for a family of related materials whose mechanical behavior varies with composition. A fixed constitutive model-form may not capture the full range of behavior across the family, while fitting separate forms does not provide a direct way to predict the response of new compositions. Recent work has developed data-driven constitutive models that learn flexible strain energy functions while incorporating key physical constraints. In this work, we propose using mixtures of convex neural potentials based on input convex neural networks as a modular and data efficient approach to modeling material families. Each potential is convex and monotonic with respect to polyconvex strain invariants, while a conditioning network maps material descriptors to mixture weights. We compare the approach with a monolithic partially input-convex neural network using experimental data from PolyJet 3D-printed materials and a synthetic Gent-type benchmark. Across both benchmarks, the mixture architecture generalized better to material descriptors not seen during training. In the PolyJet experimental benchmark, we showed that the mixture architecture is less sensitive to model hyperparameters, while in the Gent-type benchmark it generalized more reliably with sparse data in the material-descriptor space. These results suggest that representing a material family through a small set of shared convex neural potentials provides a useful structural prior for learning descriptor-dependent constitutive behavior from limited data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用基于输入凸神经网络（ICNN）的凸神经势函数混合模型来建模材料家族（material family），每个势函数相对于多凸应变不变量是凸且单调的，通过条件网络将材料描述符映射为混合权重。在PolyJet 3D打印材料和合成Gent型基准上，混合架构相比单一部分输入凸神经网络，对训练中未见过的材料描述符具有更好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统超弹性本构模型需要预先指定应变能密度函数形式并标定参数，但对于一族成分变化、力学行为各异的材料，固定的模型形式难以覆盖全部行为范围；分别拟合不同模型又无法直接预测新成分的响应。需要一种模块化、数据高效的方法来建模材料家族。
AI.method: 提出由多个输入凸神经网络组成的凸势函数混合模型。每个势函数相对于多凸应变不变量保持凸且单调，满足物理约束；一个条件网络（conditioning network）将材料描述符映射为各势函数的混合权重，从而对不同材料成分自适应地组合共享的势函数。
AI.result: 在PolyJet 3D打印材料实验基准和合成Gent型基准上，混合架构均比单一的部分输入凸神经网络（monolithic partially input-convex NN）对未见过的材料描述符具有更好的泛化能力。在PolyJet基准中混合架构对模型超参数更不敏感；在Gent型基准上，材料描述符空间数据稀疏时混合架构泛化更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 通过少量共享凸神经势函数来表示材料家族，为从有限数据中学习依赖描述符的本构行为提供了有效的结构先验，是一种模块化且数据高效的材料家族建模方案。

title: Cryogenic Enhancement of Electron Spin Polarization from a Strained GaAs/GaAsP Superlattice Photocathode
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures; Supplemental Material contains 8 pages, 3 figures, and 1 table. Ancillary files contain the measured spectra and a Jupyter notebook that reproduces figures and values, also archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22212862
summary: We report electron spin polarization of 95.0 +/- 0.8 (stat) +/- 2.4 (sys)% from a strained GaAs/GaAsP superlattice photocathode grown by metalorganic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) and cooled to dry-ice temperature (195 K). We achieved this polarization with 97.8% circularly polarized excitation light and a quantum efficiency of 0.7% at the peak polarization wavelength. This measurement exceeds the values of previously reported GaAs-based photocathode polarizations, which have clustered near 92% for two decades. We vary the temperature of the cathode and measure the polarization and quantum-efficiency spectra at 295 K, 273 K, 195 K, and 77 K. The polarization rises from 91.2(1)% at 295 K to its maximum at 195 K, while the spectral peak shifts from 775 nm to 739 nm (78 meV) over the full temperature range, tracking the widening band gap. The spectra probe two depolarization mechanisms: a thermalized transport channel that is suppressed on cooling, and energy-dependent hot-electron relaxation that persists and sets the low-temperature saturation. The polarization recovers after a full cooling and warmup cycle and is stable while the quantum efficiency decays, which disfavors surface energy filtering as the origin of the gain. These results indicate that modest cooling to 195 K, for which dry ice suffices, is a practical route to higher-polarization GaAs-based electron sources.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了采用MOCVD生长并冷却至干冰温度(195K)的应变GaAs/GaAsP超晶格光阴极实现了95%的电子自旋极化率，突破了近二十年来GaAs基光电阴极极化率徘徊在92%左右的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: GaAs基光电阴极的自旋极化率在过去二十年中一直聚集在92%左右，难以突破，限制了高能物理实验中电子束的极化度。作者希望通过温度调控等手段探索提升极化率的新途径。
AI.method: 使用MOCVD生长的应变GaAs/GaAsP超晶格光阴极，在295K、273K、195K和77K四个温度点测量极化率和量子效率谱，用97.8%圆偏振激发光激发，并分析两种去极化机制。
AI.result: 在195K时获得95.0%的电子自旋极化率，量子效率为0.7%。极化率从295K时的91.2%升至195K达到最大值，光谱峰值随温度降低从775nm蓝移至739nm。冷却-回温循环后极化率可恢复，排除了表面能量过滤机制。
AI.conclusion: 适度冷却至195K（干冰即可满足）是提高GaAs基电子源极化率的实用途径，热化输运通道在冷却时被抑制，而能量相关的热电子弛豫决定了低温饱和极化率。

title: Higher-Winding Fractionalization
summary: Higher-winding skyrmion textures can generate emergent magnetic fields with multiple flux quanta per unit cell. This opens an intriguing route toward fractionalization, allowing fractionalized quantum anomalous Hall states to arise even at integer filling of the microscopic unit cell. We show that, in this setting, increasing lattice-scale inhomogeneity of the emergent magnetic field drives a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) transition between a fractionalized liquid and a crystalline dielectric state. This transition carries a topological signature: under flux insertion, the many-body polarization defines a quantized winding number that is nonzero in the fractionalized phase and vanishes in the dielectric crystal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高绕数skyrmion纹理产生的多重磁通量子涌现磁场，发现晶格尺度不均匀性驱动分数化液体与晶体介电态之间的BKT相变，该相变具有拓扑特征：通量插入下多体极化定义量子化绕数，在分数化相中非零而在介电晶体中为零。
AI.motivation: 高绕数skyrmion纹理可在每单位晶胞产生多量子磁通，为分数化量子反常霍尔态在微观晶胞整数填充下出现提供了新途径。作者希望理解在该体系中涌现磁场晶格尺度不均匀性如何影响相行为，并寻找可观测的拓扑签名。
AI.method: 作者分析包含高绕数skyrmion纹理的系统，引入晶格尺度下的涌现磁场不均匀性作为控制参数。通过研究通量插入过程中的多体极化响应，定义量化的绕转数（winding number），用以刻画不同量子相。
AI.result: 增大涌现磁场的晶格尺度不均匀性将驱动分数化液体与晶体介电态之间的BKT相变。该相变具有明确的拓扑签名——通量插入下多体极化定义的量子化绕数在分数化相中非零，在介电晶体相中则消失为零。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作揭示了高绕数skyrmion体系中涌现磁场不均匀性作为调控分数化量子态相变的关键参量，并通过多体极化绕数提供了可识别的拓扑序表征，为理解分数化量子反常霍尔态及其相变开辟了新视角。

title: Use of Cholesky decomposition in the CFOUR program package
summary: An overview is given about our efforts to speed up high-level computations of molec- ular energies and properties using Cholesky decomposition (CD). We describe the cor- responding developments in the CFOUR quantum-chemical package with a focus on (a) the use of CD in complete-active space self-consistent-field (CASSCF) and coupled- cluster (CC) computations, (b) the implementation of analytic CC gradients using CD, (c) the efficient calculation of magnetic properties (NMR shieldings and magnetizabili- ties) using CD when carried out with explicit magnetic-field dependent basis functions, i.e., the so-called gauge-including atomic orbitals (GIAOs), (d) the efficient computa- tion of CASSCF response properties using CD, (e) the use of CD in relativistic two- and four-component computations, as well as (f) computations for molecules in finite magnetic fields using GIAOs together with CD. An outlook on future developments concerning the CFOUR package is given.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了在CFOUR量子化学软件包中利用Cholesky分解（CD）加速高精度分子能量与性质计算的工作，涵盖CASSCF、耦合簇（CC）、解析梯度、NMR屏蔽、磁化率、响应性质、相对论计算及有限磁场下的GIAO计算等多个方面。
AI.motivation: 高精度量子化学计算（如CASSCF和CC方法）计算代价高昂，需要开发高效的数值技术来加速这些计算。Cholesky分解作为一种有效的积分压缩/近似技术，能够显著降低计算成本，因此作者致力于将其系统性地应用于CFOUR程序包中。
AI.method: 在CFOUR软件包中系统地实现和开发了多种基于Cholesky分解（CD）的高效计算方法，包括：（1）CD用于CASSCF和CC计算；（2）基于CD的解析CC梯度实现；（3）结合GIAO和CD高效计算NMR屏蔽常数及磁化率等磁性质；（4）基于CD的CASSCF响应性质计算；（5）CD在相对论二分量和四分量计算中的应用；（6）CD与GIAO结合用于有限磁场中的分子计算。
AI.result: 作者成功在CFOUR包中实现了上述各类基于CD的高效计算方法，显著加速了高精度分子能量和性质的计算，并给出了未来发展的展望。
AI.conclusion: Cholesky分解已在CFOUR软件包中成为一项成熟且高效的技术，广泛应用于从多参考方法到耦合簇、从非相对论到相对论、从能量到各种响应性质的计算中，展示了其作为通用加速工具的广阔前景。

title: Nonlinear Fluctuating Hydrodynamics from Interacting Noisy Quantum Matter
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures without end matter and supplementary material
summary: A universal characterization of non-equilibrium steady states in interacting quantum many-body systems remains one of the central challenges of statistical physics. Here, we address this problem for a paradigmatic model of diffusive interacting quantum matter---the boundary-driven XXZ spin chain with bulk dephasing---and derive, directly from its microscopic Lindblad dynamics, an emergent classical Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory (MFT) governing its large-scale fluctuations. Crucially, the resulting hydrodynamics carries a density-dependent diffusivity and mobility as the fingerprint of interactions. This effective description enables the exact computation of the stationary density profile, long-range correlations, and the full counting statistics of the current, in excellent agreement with tensor-network simulations. Our work demonstrates that noisy quantum many-body systems can realize the universality class of genuinely interacting diffusive matter, beyond the constant-diffusivity class of the symmetric simple exclusion process, and establishes MFT as a powerful universal framework for interacting diffusive quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对边界驱动的XXZ自旋链（含体退相干）这一扩散型相互作用量子多体模型的典型范例，从微观Lindblad动力学出发，推导出描述其大尺度涨落的经典宏观涨落理论（MFT）。该流体动力学包含了密度依赖的扩散系数和迁移率，作为相互作用的指纹。该有效描述能够精确计算稳态密度分布、长程关联和电流的完全计数统计，与张量网络模拟高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 非平衡稳态的普适表征一直是统计物理的核心挑战之一，尤其是对相互作用量子多体系统而言，缺乏统一的宏观描述框架。
AI.method: 从边界驱动的XXZ自旋链（含体退相干）的微观Lindblad主方程出发，通过严格的推导建立宏观涨落理论（MFT），得到密度依赖的扩散系数和迁移率，并据此计算各类稳态可观测量。
AI.result: 精确计算了稳态密度分布、长程关联以及电流的完全计数统计，结果与张量网络模拟高度一致，验证了该理论框架的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 噪声量子多体系统可以实现具有真正相互作用特征的扩散物质普适类（超越对称简单排斥过程的常数扩散系数类），MFT被确立为相互作用扩散量子系统的强大普适框架。

title: Impurity-dependent quantum geometry in 2D flat band superconductors
summary: In flat band superconductors, quantum geometry, rather than kinetic energy, governs pairing and transport. However, how this geometry manifests in the response to a local, individually addressable impurity remains largely unexplored. Here, we study the Yu-Shiba-Rusinov (YSR) bound state induced by a magnetic adatom that hybridizes with every orbital of a two-dimensional flat band superconductor, and characterize its spatial profile using two quantities: the quadratic spread $Q_S$ and the localization length $ξ$. We show that $Q_S$ is not set by the quantum metric alone, as geometric corrections arising from inter-orbital interference and, more importantly, from the anisotropy of the adatom-lattice hybridization contribute on equal footing, making $Q_S$ strongly impurity dependent and tunable. On the other hand, $ξ$ emerges from the projection onto the flat band alone and is a universal property set by the overlap of compact localized states. All impurity dependence is instead isolated in the prefactor of the wavefunction whose magnitude correlates directly with $Q_S$. We, therefore, report a clean separation between universal and impurity-tunable physics from the induced YSR bound state in these systems, and confirm our results numerically via exact diagonalization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了平带超导体中磁吸附原子诱导的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov（YSR）束缚态，发现其空间分布可用两个量表征：二次扩展QS（强烈依赖杂质构型，可调控）和局域长度ξ（仅由平带投影决定，是普适性质），实现了普适物理与杂质可调物理的干净分离。
AI.motivation: 平带超导体中量子几何（而非动能）主导配对与输运，但量子几何如何体现在局域、可独立寻址杂质的响应中仍未被探索。作者旨在填补这一空白，理解磁吸附原子诱导的YSR束缚态如何反映平带体系的量子几何。
AI.method: 作者研究了一个与二维平带超导体中每个轨道都杂化的磁吸附原子诱导的YSR束缚态，用两个量刻画其空间分布：二次扩展QS和局域长度ξ。通过解析分析结合精确对角化的数值验证，考察量子度规修正、轨道间干涉以及吸附原子-晶格杂化的各向异性对空间分布的影响。
AI.result: QS并非仅由量子度规决定，轨道间干涉的几何修正以及吸附原子-晶格杂化的各向异性贡献同等重要，使QS强烈依赖杂质且可调谐。相反，ξ仅由平带投影决定，是受紧致局域态重叠支配的普适性质，所有杂质依赖性被隔离在波函数的前因子中，其大小与QS直接关联。
AI.conclusion: 作者在平带超导体诱导的YSR束缚态中报道了普适物理与杂质可调物理之间的干净分离：局域长度ξ为普适性质，而二次扩展QS为杂质依赖的可调性质，并通过精确对角化数值确认了该结论。

title: Entanglement from particle number fluctuations in a second-order topological insulator
summary: Higher-order topological insulators are materials with a bulk energy gap featuring gapless modes at $(d-n)$-dimensional edges, where $n > 1$. Despite this modified bulk-boundary correspondence, their nontrivial topology can nevertheless be observed through the bipartite entanglement spectrum. Inspired by works suggesting fluctuations in conserved quantities could be used to study topology in one-dimensional systems, which likewise feature zero-dimensional edge modes, we extend this treatment to a two-dimensional second-order topological insulator where corner states play an analogous role. We show that the standard bipartite entanglement entropy and particle number fluctuation lack striking signals of topological phase transitions, both in the static case and in the time evolution after a quench, obscured by an area-law term from the subsystem edges. By introducing a quadripartite construction of the subsystem, we show that it is possible to isolate the topological contributions, producing sharp transition peaks in both quantities, observable by studying subsystems much smaller than the full system. As particle number fluctuations are accessible in existing experiments, these results establish a concrete and scalable path to experimental detection of the entanglement in higher-order topological insulators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用四部分（quadripartite）子系统的粒子数涨落来探测二维二阶拓扑绝缘体中的拓扑相变，克服了标准二分裂纠缠熵和粒子数涨落被面积律项掩盖的问题，为高阶拓扑绝缘体的实验探测提供了可行路径。
AI.motivation: 高阶拓扑绝缘体具有修改的体-边界对应关系，其拓扑性质可通过二分纠缠谱观察。受一维系统中利用守恒量涨落研究拓扑（零维边缘模）的启发，作者希望将这一方法推广到二维二阶拓扑绝缘体（角态扮演类似角色），但面临面积律项掩盖拓扑信号的挑战。
AI.method: 作者首先证明标准二分纠缠熵和粒子数涨落（静态及淬灭后时间演化中）均缺乏明显的拓扑相变信号，原因是子系统边缘的面积律贡献掩盖了拓扑项。随后引入四部分（quadripartite）子系统构造，通过这种设计隔离拓扑贡献，从而在纠缠熵和粒子数涨落中产生尖锐的相变峰，且可通过远小于全系统的子系统观测到。
AI.result: 四部分构造能够在纠缠熵和粒子数涨落中产生清晰的拓扑相变峰，克服了面积律项的掩盖效应，且所需子系统尺寸可远小于整个系统，具有很好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 由于粒子数涨落在现有实验中可测，这些结果建立了在高阶拓扑绝缘体中实验探测纠缠的具象且可扩展的路径。

title: A Non-Isothermal Viscoplastic Constitutive Model for Clay Slip Surfaces
summary: Clayey slip surfaces control the reactivation and long-term deformation of slow-moving landslides and may experience thermal fluctuations from climate, seasonal ground-temperature changes, or subsurface heat sources. Experiments show that residual shear strength depends on temperature and shearing rate, yet most numerical approaches use temperature-independent strength parameters. We present a non-isothermal viscoplastic constitutive model for clayey slip surfaces implemented with zero-thickness interface elements. It includes temperature-dependent normal and tangential stiffness, progressive degradation of cohesion and friction angle, and rate-dependent viscoplastic slip governed by a non-associated flow rule. Coupling with hydraulic and thermal balance equations allows the interface response to evolve with stress state, temperature, aperture, and accumulated irreversible displacement. Validation against temperature-controlled drained ring-shear tests on bentonite and smectite-rich soils covers heating--cooling, cooling--heating, and combined thermal paths. The simulations reproduce thermal strengthening at slow shearing rates and thermal weakening or limited sensitivity at higher rates. Application to the Congress Street cut benchmark shows that zero-thickness elements improve the representation of strain localization and progressive failure. Increasing temperature progressively degrades interface strength, increases displacement, joint aperture, and shear strain, and accelerates sliding. Temperature-dependent interface degradation can therefore reduce the apparent stability margin of clayey slopes and should be included in slope-stability assessments involving thermal fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个非等温粘塑性本构模型，用于描述黏土滑动面在温度变化下的长期变形行为，通过零厚度界面单元实现，并在环剪试验和边坡基准案例中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 黏土滑动面控制着缓慢滑坡的复活和长期变形，会受到气候、季节性地面温度变化或地下热源的影响。实验表明残余剪切强度依赖温度和剪切速率，但大多数数值方法使用与温度无关的强度参数，忽略了温度对边坡稳定性的影响。
AI.method: 提出了一个非等温粘塑性本构模型，包含温度相关的法向和切向刚度、内聚力和摩擦角的渐进退化，以及由非关联流动法则控制的速率相关粘塑性滑移。模型通过零厚度界面单元实现，并与水力和热平衡方程耦合，使界面响应随应力状态、温度、孔隙和水久不可逆位移演化。
AI.result: 模型在膨润土和富含蒙脱石土壤的温度控制排水环剪试验中得到验证，涵盖了加热-冷却、冷却-加热及组合热路径，成功再现了慢剪切速率下的热强化和高速率下的热弱化。应用于Congress Street cut基准案例表明，零厚度界面单元改善了应变局部化和渐进破坏的描述，温度升高会渐进退化界面强度、增加位移和滑动速度。
AI.conclusion: 温度相关的界面退化会降低黏土边坡的表观稳定裕度，在涉及热波动的边坡稳定性评估中应考虑温度效应。

title: Multi-image Overlap Stitching and Automatic Image Construction for Coherent X-ray Imaging
summary: Direct-space and real-time coherent X-ray imaging (direct-CXI) enables visualization of magnetic-domain structures and dynamics over length scales exceeding the field of view of a single image. However, large-area measurements typically require raster scanning, producing hundreds of partially overlapping images that must be accurately aligned and combined before quantitative analysis can be performed. Here, we present Multi-image Overlap Stitching and Automatic Image Construction for coherent X-ray imaging (MOSAICX), an automated stitching workflow for large-area direct-space coherent X-ray imaging. The workflow consists of image centering, masking, trimming, binarization, hierarchical stitching, and post-processing. To demonstrate the method, we apply it to a dataset comprising 434 direct-CXI images of the antiferromagnetic topological insulator MnBi$_2$Te$_4$. The images are first combined into column reconstructions and subsequently stitched into a single large-area composite image. The resulting reconstruction reveals the complete magnetic-domain and domain-wall landscape over the scanned region while suppressing imaging artifacts and detector defects. The presented workflow provides an efficient approach for processing large direct-CXI datasets and enables visualization and analysis of magnetic-domain structures beyond the field of view of individual measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOSAICX，一种用于大范围直接空间相干X射线成像（direct-CXI）的自动化拼接工作流程，包含图像居中、掩膜、裁剪、二值化、层次化拼接和后处理六个步骤。该方法应用于434张MnBi₂Te₄反铁磁拓扑绝缘体的图像，成功拼接成单一大幅面合成图像，揭示完整磁畴与畴壁结构，同时抑制成像伪影和探测器缺陷。
AI.motivation: 直接空间相干X射线成像能够可视化超出单幅图像视野的磁畴结构和动力学，但大面积测量需要光栅扫描产生数百张部分重叠的图像，在定量分析前必须进行精确对准和合并，这一过程缺乏自动化且费时费力。
AI.method: 工作流程包括六个步骤：图像居中、掩膜处理、裁剪、二值化、层次化拼接以及后处理。首先将图像在列方向上组合为列重建图，随后将列重建图拼接成单一大幅面合成图像。
AI.result: 该方法成功应用于包含434张direct-CXI图像的MnBi₂Te₄数据集，生成了覆盖整个扫描区域的完整磁畴和畴壁景观重建，同时有效抑制了成像伪影和探测器缺陷。
AI.conclusion: MOSAICX提供了一种高效处理大型direct-CXI数据集的方法，使磁畴结构的可视化和分析能够超越单次测量的视野限制。

title: Engineering tunable $p$-wave magnetism in antiferromagnetic bilayers
summary: We propose a symmetry-guided route to engineer tunable $p$-wave magnetism in a bilayer system composed of two AB-stacked antiferromagnetic square lattices with their collinear moments nonparallel to each other. We show that an in-plane relative shift between the two layers selectively breaks the symmetries protecting spin degeneracy while preserving time-reversal-related constraints, thereby generating odd-parity spin splitting in a fully compensated magnetic state without spin-orbit coupling. The direction and the magnitude of the resulting $p$-wave spin-splitting, together with the associated spin responses, can be continuously tuned by the in-plane displacement, providing a potential knob for control. We further map the bilayer system onto an effective bond-modulated square lattice and investigate the corresponding Hubbard model within a mean-field framework. The calculated phase diagram reveals extended regions where $p$-wave magnetism with coplanar or chiral spin textures emerges spontaneously. Our results establish a minimal equilibrium platform for realizing and manipulating $p$-wave magnetism in two-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于对称性指导的路线，在双层系统中实现可调的p波磁性。该系统由两个AB堆叠的反铁磁方格子组成，其共线磁矩互不平行。通过层间平面位移选择性破坏保护自旋简并的对称性，同时保持时间反演相关约束，从而在无自旋轨道耦合的完全补偿磁态中产生奇宇称自旋劈裂。p波自旋劈裂的方向和大小可通过面内位移连续调节。通过将双层系统映射到有效键调制方格子并在平均场框架下研究Hubbard模型，相图显示共面或手性自旋织构的p波磁性可自发涌现，确立了二维系统中实现和操控p波磁性的最小平衡平台。
AI.motivation: 传统p波磁性（如交错磁性）通常依赖于特定的晶体对称性和自旋轨道耦合。作者希望探索一种无需自旋轨道耦合、可在完全补偿磁态中产生奇宇称自旋劈裂的机制，并通过几何位移这一额外的调控手段实现磁性的连续可调性，为二维磁性系统提供新的操控自由度。
AI.method: 采用对称性分析方法研究双层AB堆叠反铁磁方格子系统，通过面内层间相对位移选择性地打破保护自旋简并的对称性；随后将双层系统映射为有效键调制方格子，在平均场框架下对相应的Hubbard模型进行求解，绘制相图以研究p波磁性的自发涌现及自旋织构。
AI.result: 证明了面内位移可以产生无自旋轨道耦合的奇宇称自旋劈裂，且劈裂方向与大小可连续调节；平均场相图显示存在广泛的区域，其中共面或手性自旋织构的p波磁性可自发涌现。
AI.conclusion: 建立了二维系统中实现和操控p波磁性的最小平衡平台，为无需自旋轨道耦合的可调自旋电子学器件提供了理论基础。

title: Diagnosing Latent Energy Decomposition in Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials via Interacting Quantum Atoms
summary: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) can reproduce potential energies and forces accurately, but their internal energy allocation is often difficult to interpret. E3D-IQA is introduced as a diagnostic framework connecting the latent edge-energy representation of an Allegro-type MLIP with Interacting Quantum Atoms (IQA) energy decomposition. The Allegro edge-energy path is retained as a latent pair contribution, while a node-energy path is trained against the IQA intra-atomic energy. IQA interatomic energies are not direct training targets; instead, the learned edge energies are evaluated after training against the IQA pair terms. Tests on H/C/N/O organic reaction structures show that intra-atomic supervision is essential: energy and force training alone does not recover an IQA-like one-body/two-body allocation. With intra-atomic supervision, node energies reproduce IQA intra-atomic terms, and latent edge energies show meaningful correspondence with IQA interatomic terms. Residual errors are concentrated in positive or weak pair interactions, exposing internal allocation failures that remain hidden in total-energy and force metrics. Adding structures labeled only with energies and forces improves transfer to larger molecules and reduces decomposition errors. E3D-IQA therefore provides a route for diagnosing and guiding latent scientific representations using partially labeled quantum-chemical datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出E3D-IQA框架，将Allegro型机器学习原子间势的潜在边能量表示与相互作用的量子原子（IQA）能量分解相连接，通过增加原子内能量监督实现可解释的能量分配。研究表明该方法能恢复IQA-like的一体/两体能分配，为诊断和引导潜在科学表征提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）虽然能准确再现势能和力，但其内部能量分配往往难以解释。理解能量的分解（如原子内与原子间贡献）对于揭示化学键合和相互作用本质至关重要，因此需要一种能将黑盒模型与物理能量分解理论相结合的诊断框架。
AI.method: E3D-IQA框架包含两条路径：保留Allegro边能量作为潜在的成对（pair）贡献路径，以及训练节点能量路径以匹配IQA原子内能量。IQA原子间能量不直接作为训练目标，而是在训练后评估学习的边能量与IQA配对项的对应关系。在H/C/N/O有机反应结构上进行测试。
AI.result: 发现原子内监督至关重要：仅训练能量和力无法恢复IQA-like的一体/两体能量分配。在原子内监督下，节点能量可再现IQA原子内项，潜在边能量与IQA原子间项具有有意义的对应关系。残差误差集中在正或弱配对相互作用中，揭示出在总能量和力指标中隐藏的内部分配失败。增加仅带能量和力的标签结构可改善向更大分子的迁移并减少分解误差。
AI.conclusion: E3D-IQA提供了一种利用部分标注的量子化学数据集来诊断和引导潜在科学表征的途径，使MLIP不仅预测正确，还能以物理上可解释的方式分配能量。

title: Duality between the level statistics of Hermitian and non-Hermitian random matrices
summary: Random matrix theory describes complex quantum systems statistically, with symmetry as its organizing principle. We uncover an exact duality between the level statistics of Hermitian and non-Hermitian random matrices in the large-$N$ (matrix size) limit. It acts class by class: the two replica partition functions, given by fermionic nonlinear $σ$ models, are related by analytic continuation. Applied to the three Wigner--Dyson classes, the duality yields the universal bulk eigenvalue pair-correlation functions of non-Hermitian random matrices. This establishes a non-Hermitian counterpart of Dyson's threefold way, organized by transposition symmetry: generic complex, complex symmetric, and complex self-dual matrices. The dissipative spectral form factors of these classes follow in closed form as well. Applied to the seven nonstandard Altland--Zirnbauer classes, the duality yields the exact spectral densities near the origin, the non-Hermitian hard-edge statistics. Most of these statistics were previously known only numerically. Exact diagonalization confirms the analytical predictions, and physical models demonstrate their universality. We expect these results to be the tip of a deeper correspondence between Hermitian and non-Hermitian random matrix theory.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了大型Hermitian和非Hermitian随机矩阵在极限下的能级统计之间的精确对偶性，该对偶按对称类逐一成立。通过解析延拓将两者的副本配分函数（费米子非线性σ模型）联系起来，并将此框架应用于Wigner-Dyson三类和Altland-Zirnbauer七类，推导出普适的本征值关联函数、耗散谱形状因子及非Hermitian硬边统计。
AI.motivation: 非Hermitian随机矩阵理论许多重要统计量（尤其是硬边统计）此前仅能通过数值方法获得，缺乏解析框架。作者希望建立Hermitian与非Hermitian随机矩阵理论之间更深层的对应关系，以系统化的对称性原理组织非Hermitian随机矩阵的普适类，类比Dyson三重分类。
AI.method: 作者使用副本方法，将两类矩阵的配分函数分别表示为费米子非线性σ模型，发现在大N极限下两者通过解析延拓相联系，形成逐类成立的精确对偶。利用该对偶，从已知的Hermitian结果推导非Hermitian统计量：对Wigner-Dyson三类推导普适体态对关联函数与耗散谱形状因子的闭式表达；对Altland-Zirnbauer七类推导原点附近的精确谱密度。数值精确对角化验证解析结果。
AI.result: 建立了以转置对称为组织原理的非Hermitian三重分类（一般复、复对称、复自对偶矩阵），对应Dyson三重分类的非Hermitian版本。给出各耗散谱形状因子的闭式解，以及对Altland-Zirnbauer七类原点的精确谱密度（此前多仅数值已知），并通过精确对角化和物理模型确认其普适性。
AI.conclusion: 这一工作为Hermitian与非Hermitian随机矩阵理论之间建立了系统性的对偶桥梁，指出这是更深层对应关系的开端。该对偶框架有望推广至更多对称类及更广泛物理场景。

title: Comment on "Distinct Behaviors of Inner and Outer CuO$_2$ Planes in Quadruple-Layer Cuprate (Cu,C)Ba$_2$Ca$_3$Cu$_4$O$_{11 + δ}$"
summary: In a recent Letter, Sun et al. report photoemission spectroscopy measurements on the four-layer cuprate (Cu,C)Ba2Ca3Cu4O11 (CuC-1234) in which they resolve two superconducting gaps associated with the inner (IP) and outer (OP) CuO2 planes. CuC-1234 has a Tc as 117 K in a sample previously structurally characterized using neutron powder diffraction. From the Luttinger sum, the beta-band of the IP was found to be heavily underdoped (p~0.07) while the OP alpha2 bonding band was strongly overdoped (p~0.25). Each revealed a gap with very different momentum and temperature dependences. A large gap on the beta band was found to close at the bulk Tc, while a smaller gap on the alpha2 band closed at 70 K. Such two-gap behavior would indicate weak-coupling between the IP and OP, resulting in a second gap-opening temperature, Tc2, and implying a two-step development of the superfluid density on cooling, first on the IPs then on the OPs. Here, we point out that the observed values of Tc and Tc2 are fully consistent with a long-standing correlation of Tc with a bond-valence sum parameter, V+, calculated from the crystallographic bond lengths. This suggests that Tc2 in the OP is entirely consistent with the local structure of the OP where the value of V+(OP) is reduced by the presence of the apical oxygens and Tc2 reduced accordingly. It is as though two largely decoupled superconductors are present in the single 1234 compound and their individual pairing temperatures are determined by their local nearest-neighbour structure, reflecting the very short-range physics.

AI.tldr: 本文对四层铜氧化物超导体(Cu,C)Ba2Ca3Cu4O11中观测到的两个超导能隙提出解释，认为内平面与外平面表现出弱耦合的双超导体行为，其各自的配对温度由局部化学键结构（键价和参数V+）决定，与块体Tc和次能隙温度Tc2完全吻合。
AI.motivation: Sun等人的光电子能谱实验在四层铜氧化物中分辨出两个超导能隙（内平面β带和外平面α2带），分别在不同温度关闭，暗示IP与OP之间存在弱耦合。作者希望解释为何会在同一化合物中出现两个基本去耦合的超导转变温度。
AI.method: 作者将实验观测到的Tc=117 K和Tc2=70 K与基于晶体学键长计算的键价和参数V+的长期相关性进行比较分析，证明OP的局部结构中顶角氧的存在降低了V+(OP)值，从而使Tc2相应降低。
AI.result: 分析表明观测的Tc和Tc2值与V+参数的相关性完全一致：IP与OP如同两个很大程度上去耦合的超导体共存于同一1234化合物中，各自的配对温度由其最近邻局部结构决定。
AI.conclusion: 该工作支持非常短程的物理机制决定铜氧化物超导体的配对温度，局部化学键结构而非仅仅层间耦合强度是理解双层隙行为的关键。

title: Chiral phonons driven by chiral cavities
summary: Lattice vibrations carrying angular momentum give rise to fundamental phenomena such as the phonon Hall effect and the Einstein-de Haas effect, offering new opportunities for manipulating angular momentum in condensed-matter systems. Generating such circularly polarized phonons requires either the use of an external magnetic field, or of polarized light pulses. The latter approach does not require the use of any magnetic response of the material, but it has limitations, in particular regarding the duration of the pulse. Consequently, any effect stemming from phonons generated by light pulses is transient. In this paper, we propose the use of a driven electromagnetic cavity as a route to generate a steady-state population of chiral phonons. We derive a general description of cavity-chiral phonon interaction, with a particular focus on modes of chiral cavities. We show that, under optimized conditions, a significant effective phonon-induced magnetic field can be generated by means of an external drive with realistic power. Our approach is specially tailored for Gamma point phonons with THz frequencies, and opens a new route for investigating chiral phonons with electromagnetic cavities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用驱动电磁腔来产生稳态手性声子（携带角动量的晶格振动），克服了传统光脉冲方法只能产生瞬态效应的局限性。在优化条件下，通过外部驱动可产生显著的声子诱导等效磁场，为研究手性声子开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 携带角动量的手性声子可引发声子霍尔效应和爱因斯坦-德哈斯效应等基本物理现象，具有重要的科学意义。然而，现有产生手性声子的方法（外加磁场或偏振光脉冲）存在明显局限：前者依赖材料的磁响应，后者产生的效应是瞬态的。因此需要一种能够持续产生稳态手性声子的新方法。
AI.method: 作者提出使用驱动电磁腔来产生稳态手性声子群。他们推导了腔-手性声子相互作用的普适描述，特别关注手性腔模式的特征。通过分析外部驱动与腔模式的耦合机制，研究在特定优化条件下声子-腔耦合所产生的有效磁场强度。
AI.result: 研究表明，在优化条件下，利用具有现实功率的外部驱动，可以产生显著的声子诱导等效磁场。该方法特别适用于Gamma点的太赫兹频率声子模式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作开辟了利用电磁腔研究手性声子的新途径，为在凝聚态系统中持续操控角动量提供了新方案，有望推动手性声子相关现象的实验研究和潜在应用。

title: GW and Bethe-Salpeter Theory for Molecular Polaritons, Quasiparticles, and Excitons
summary: The electron self-energy is central to quasiparticle theory, yet how an optical cavity enters it remains unclear. We address this question for a molecule in a single-mode cavity using the dipole-gauge Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian and a coherent-state QED Hartree-Fock reference. The cavity enters through three channels: the static dipole self-energy (DSE) shift of reference orbital energies, direct DSE augmentation of the screened interaction, and the polariton pole carrying the bilinear electron-photon coupling. We benchmark QED-$GW$ ionization potentials (IPs) and electron affinities (EAs) against a cavity $Δ$-method ladder from QED-HF to correlated wave-function methods, whose cavity-induced shifts agree within 1 meV where directly comparable. For closed-shell molecules with unbound anions, $GW$ systematically overestimates cavity-induced IP redshifts, whereas EA shifts are reproduced nearly quantitatively, although this does not imply comparable accuracy for absolute EAs. For ionic molecules with bound anions, this ordering reverses, consistent with published QED coupled-cluster results. Coupling and detuning scans show that the error is predominantly quadratic in $λ$ and DSE-driven rather than resonant. The spectral function develops a polariton-replica photoemission sideband with weight scaling as $λ^2$. In the static screened interaction used in the Bethe-Salpeter equation, bare-photon exchange cancels the matching DSE contribution to the direct interaction, while exchange and polariton-screening corrections remain. Their net effect on the lowest excitation is appreciable only for ammonia in the molecules studied. Exciton-binding energies involving unbound anions are strongly basis-dependent and should therefore be viewed as diagnostics of electron-hole interactions rather than basis-converged molecular quantities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了光腔如何通过三种通道进入电子自能，发展了QED-GW方法，并将其电离势和电子亲和能的腔诱导偏移与QED-Δ方法阶梯基准进行了系统对比。
AI.motivation: 电子自能是准粒子理论的核心，但光腔如何进入电子自能这一问题尚不清楚。需要厘清腔场在QED-GW框架中的具体作用路径，并评估其预测精度。
AI.method: 采用偶极规范Pauli-Fierz哈密顿量和相干态QED Hartree-Fock参考态，识别出腔进入的三种通道：静态偶极自能(DSE)对参考轨道能的偏移、DSE对屏蔽相互作用的直接增强、以及携带双线性电子-光子耦合的极化激元极点。建立了QED-GW方法并与从QED-HF到相关波函数方法的腔Δ方法阶梯进行基准对比。
AI.result: 对于闭壳层分子中未束缚阴离子，GW系统性地高估腔诱导电离势红移，而电子亲和能偏移几乎可定量重现。对于具有束缚阴离子的离子分子，趋势反转，与已发表的QED耦合簇结果一致。耦合和失谐扫描表明误差主要与λ²成正比且由DSE驱动而非共振效应。谱函数出现权重按λ²标度的极化激元复制光电子边带。在BSE静态屏蔽相互作用中，裸光子交换抵消了直接相互作用中匹配的DSE贡献，而交换和极化激元屏蔽修正仍保留。激子结合能在涉及未束缚阴离子时强依赖基组。
AI.conclusion: QED-GW在电子亲和能方面几乎定量准确，但对涉及未束缚阴离子的电离势腔诱导偏移存在系统性高估；误差主要由DSE驱动而非共振。腔诱导的激子结合能应视为电子-空穴相互作用的诊断量而非基组收敛的分子量。

title: XUV Transmission Spectroscopy Using a Tabletop High-Harmonic Source
summary: High-harmonic generation (HHG) provides a coherent ultrashort-pulse light source in the extreme- ultraviolet (XUV) region and has potential applications in time-resolved spectroscopy and materials characterization. In this study, we constructed an HHG system using a Yb:KGW laser system (PHAROS, Light Conversion) as the driving source and Ar gas as the nonlinear medium. High-order harmonics were observed up to a photon energy of 70.6 eV, corresponding to the 59th harmonic order. As an application of the developed XUV source, we measured the transmission of a Mg thin film and a Si3N4 membrane. In addition, the surface chemical state of the Mg thin film was characterized by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and the results were compared with the transmission measured using the HHG source. This comparison was used to examine the relationship between the surface condition, including surface oxidation, and the XUV transmission of the Mg thin film. These results demonstrate the applicability of the developed Ar-based HHG source to the characterization of thin-film transmission in the XUV spectral region.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Yb:KGW激光系统和Ar气体构建了高次谐波产生(HHG)系统，成功观测到高达70.6 eV光子能量（59阶谐波）的极紫外光源，并将其应用于Mg薄膜和Si3N4薄膜的透射测量，结合XPS分析研究了表面氧化与XUV透射的关系。
AI.motivation: 高次谐波产生(HHG)能够提供极紫外(XUV)区域的相干超短脉冲光源，在时间分辨光谱和材料表征方面具有重要应用潜力。作者旨在开发一套基于Ar气体的HHG系统，并将其应用于薄膜透射特性表征。
AI.method: 使用Yb:KGW激光系统(PHAROS)作为驱动源，Ar气体作为非线性介质构建HHG系统；用该系统测量Mg薄膜和Si3N4膜的透射；通过XPS表征Mg薄膜表面化学状态，并将XPS结果与HHG源测量的透射数据进行比较。
AI.result: 观测到高次谐波直到70.6 eV光子能量（第59阶谐波）；成功测量了Mg薄膜和Si3N4膜的透射；XPS分析显示Mg薄膜表面氧化状态与XUV透射之间存在关联。
AI.conclusion: 所开发的基于Ar的HHG源可用于XUV光谱区域薄膜透射特性的表征，展示了该光源的实用性和应用价值。

title: Bound states, resonances, and their thermodynamic properties in pseudospin-1 systems with short-range impurities
summary: Bound states and resonances induced by short-range impurities modeled by circular potential wells are analyzed in the vicinity of flat and dispersive bands in gapped and gapless pseudospin-1 systems. We find that the bound and resonant states derived from the flat band show unusual characteristics originating from the multicomponent structure of pseudospin-1 fermions, which are distinct from those for pseudospin-$\tfrac{1}{2}$ fermions. Contrary to gapped Dirac systems and unlike bound states in the vicinity of the upper dispersive band, the bound states derived from the flat band occur for any value of the total angular momentum. The energies of these bound states with higher angular momentum $j$ tend to decrease with $|j|$. In addition, it is found that their wave functions are localized at the potential well edge and the localization increases with $|j|$. The signatures of the impurity states in the local density of states are determined. Using the Anderson model for independent electrons in the disorder potential, the thermodynamic potential, entropy density, and heat capacity are obtained. In the regime dominated by bound states derived from the flat band, the entropy density monotonically increases with temperature and saturates, whereas the heat capacity exhibits a single maximum.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了赝自旋-1系统中平面能带附近的短程杂质（圆形势阱）诱导的束缚态和共振态，发现其具有与赝自旋-1/2系统不同的奇特性质，并分析了杂质态对热力学量的影响。
AI.motivation: 探索赝自旋-1系统（如狄拉克-魏尔类材料）中平面能带受杂质扰动产生的束缚态与共振态特性，特别关注其与赝自旋-1/2系统在物理行为上的差异，以理解多分量结构对这些态的影响。
AI.method: 利用圆形势阱建模短程杂质，在有隙和无隙的赝自旋-1系统中分析平面能带和色散能带附近的束缚态与共振态；结合Anderson模型计算无序势下的热力学势、熵密度和热容。
AI.result: 平面能带衍生的束缚态出现在任意总角动量j下（不同于赝自旋-1/2系统）；高j束缚态能量随|j|增大而降低，且波函数在势阱边缘局域化并随|j|增强；在束缚态主导的温区，熵密度随温度单调增加并饱和，热容呈现单峰。
AI.conclusion: 赝自旋-1系统中平面能带衍生的杂质束缚态具有独特的角动量依赖性和局域化特征，体现在热力学量上表现出可观测的熵饱和与热容单峰行为。

title: Reference-Density Hartree Screening for Gausslet Hamiltonians
summary: Gausslets are among the few electronic-structure bases that permit the four-index electron--electron interaction to be replaced by an accurate two-index integral diagonal approximation (IDA). Near a many-electron nucleus, however, the nuclear attraction and core-electron Hartree field are individually large and substantially cancel. Treating the first as a full finite-basis matrix while treating the second with IDA leaves an avoidable imbalance. We introduce reference-density Hartree screening: the Hartree field of a chosen reference density is represented accurately, and IDA is applied only to density fluctuations about it. Tests on He, Ne, atomic F, F$_2$, and Cr$_2$ show large reductions in direct Hartree errors, including transfer of fitted neutral-atom fields to molecules. For Cr$_2$, atomic-core screening prevents the spurious HF collapse found with the unscreened $q=5$ and $q=7$ Hamiltonians, whereas finite-reference matching without screening does not. Screening leaves exchange and residual correlation unchanged. We therefore also introduce a low-rank one-particle correction that uses an accurate conventional Gaussian-basis Hartree--Fock calculation to match either occupied-space exchange information or the complete occupied Fock vectors. In F$_2$ and Cr$_2$, $X_{\rm HF}$ reproduces the finite-reference energy and occupied Fock vectors to numerical precision and the selected states return after orbital perturbations. For Cr$_2$, the corrected $q=5$ basis uses one quarter as many functions as the $q=7$ control while retaining sub-mHa mean-field accuracy. Screening provides the physical improvement to the direct field; the state-specific correction then restores the remaining accuracy of the Gaussian-basis mean-field reference.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电子结构计算中Gausslets基组的四指数电子-电子相互作用近似（IDA）问题，提出参考密度Hartree屏蔽方案：对参考密度的Hartree场进行精确表示，仅对密度涨落应用IDA。在He、Ne、F、F₂和Cr₂上的测试表明该方案大幅降低直接Hartree误差，并能防止Cr₂中未屏蔽Hamiltonian导致的虚假HF坍缩。此外引入低秩单粒子修正X_HF，利用准确的传统高斯基组HF计算匹配占据空间交换信息或完整占据Fock向量，使修正后的q=5基组在保持亚mHa平均场精度同时仅需q=7基组四分之一的函数数。
AI.motivation: Gausslets基组虽能用两指数积分对角近似（IDA）替代四指数电子-电子相互作用，但在多电子原子核附近，核吸引势与核心电子Hartree场各自很大且近似抵消。若将前者作为完整有限基矩阵处理而后者用IDA处理，会引入可避免的不平衡误差，导致如Cr₂中未屏蔽Hamiltonian出现虚假的HF坍缩。
AI.method: (1) 提出参考密度Hartree屏蔽：选取参考密度并精确表示其Hartree场，仅对围绕参考密度的涨落应用IDA。(2) 引入低秩单粒子修正X_HF：利用传统高斯基组的精确Hartree-Fock计算，匹配占据空间交换信息或完整占据Fock向量，以恢复剩余精度。屏蔽改变直接场，修正恢复基组平均场参考的精度，交换和残差关联不受影响。
AI.result: 在He、Ne、原子F、F₂和Cr₂上的测试显示直接Hartree误差大幅降低，可迁移拟合中性原子场到分子。对Cr₂，原子核心屏蔽防止了未屏蔽q=5和q=7 Hamiltonian的虚假HF坍缩，而仅有限参考匹配无屏蔽则不能。X_HF在F₂和Cr₂中能数值精度级复现有限参考能量和占据Fock向量。修正后的q=5基组仅用q=7基组的四分之一函数数，仍保持亚mHa平均场精度。
AI.conclusion: 参考密度Hartree屏蔽提供了对直接场物理上的改进，state-specific修正X_HF则恢复高斯基组平均场参考的剩余精度。两者结合使Gausslets基组在保持IDA计算效率优势的同时，克服了多电子原子核附近平衡性不足的问题，实现了更高效且更准确的电子结构计算。

title: Exact joint eigenvalue densities of non-Hermitian random matrices are Calogero scattering states
summary: Determining exact joint eigenvalue densities is central to random matrix theory. We solve this long-standing problem for non-Hermitian matrices with transposition symmetry (complex symmetric and complex self-dual) at arbitrary matrix size. Up to a Vandermonde factor, they are scattering-state wave functions of the Calogero model, a line of particles interacting through an inverse-square potential, with the coupling strength set by the symmetry. In contrast to many previously known joint densities, the densities cannot be written as a gas of eigenvalues with pairwise interactions. We further compute the complex level spacing distributions and two-point spectral correlation functions, which carry power-law tails, absent in a Coulomb gas. Our results shed light on the interplay among random matrices, integrability, and symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了非厄米矩阵在转置对称性（复对称和复自对偶）下的精确联合特征值密度问题，任意矩阵尺寸下均成立。该密度在Vandermonde因式之外对应于Calogero模型的散射态波函数，耦合强度由对称性决定。与以往许多联合密度不同，该密度不能写成具有成对相互作用的特征值气体形式。文中还计算了复能级间距分布和两点谱关联函数，它们具有库仑气体中不存在的幂律尾巴。
AI.motivation: 确定精确的联合特征值密度是随机矩阵理论的核心问题，但对于具有转置对称性的非厄米矩阵（如复对称矩阵和复自对偶矩阵），这一长期悬而未决的问题此前一直未获解决。
AI.method: 将联合特征值密度与Calogero模型（一维反平方势相互作用粒子链）的散射态波函数建立联系，以Vandermonde因子提取后识别出其内在可积结构，据此推导出一般尺寸下的精确密度表达。
AI.result: 获得了复对称与复自对偶非厄米矩阵在任意尺寸下的精确联合特征值密度；进一步计算了复能级间距分布与两点谱关联函数，发现了具有幂律衰变尾巴的谱关联特性——这与传统的库仑气体/特征值气体行为截然不同。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了随机矩阵、可积性与对称性之间的深层联系，表明在转置对称非厄米体系下，谱统计不能简单归约为特征值气体模型，需要借助可积场论（Calogero模型）的框架来理解。

title: Heavily Sr-Doped La$_{2}$SrNi$_{2}$O$_{7-δ}$ as a Tetragonal Ruddlesden-Popper Phase at Ambient Pressure
summary: High-temperature superconductivity has been found in bilayer Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates in bulk samples under high pressure, or in thin films via compressive strain. In the superconducting state, a tetragonal structure with a straight Ni-O-Ni bond along c-axis has been commonly observed, together with the suppression or diminishing of the density-wave orders. Therefore, it remains an open question whether these factors are sufficient for achieving superconductivity at ambient pressure. Here we report the first successful synthesis of heavily Sr-doped La$_{2}$SrNi$_{2}$O$_{7-δ}$ under high-pressure and high-temperature (HPHT) conditions with a flux method. X-ray diffraction and scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) confirm that the material adopts a tetragonal (I4/mmm) structure with an 180$^{\circ}$ Ni-O-Ni bond angle along c-axis. Resistance measurements reveal metallic behavior with a low-temperature upturn and no density-wave features are observed. However, neither pressure nor oxygen variation induces superconductivity. Density functional theory calculations indicate that the holes introduced by Sr doping are predominantly doped into the Ni-3d$_{z^2}$ orbital, leading to the appearance of a very large $γ$ pocket on the Fermi surface at ambient pressure and significantly reducing the occupation of the Ni-3d$_{z^2 }$ orbital. Combining the experimental observations with theoretical calculations, we attribute the absence of superconductivity to the serious deviation from the half-filling state of the Ni-3d$_{z^2 }$ band, which is crucial for the interlayer antiferromagnetic interaction and thus for pairing. Our work unravels important issues for achieving superconductivity in bilayer nickelate system.

AI.tldr: 本文首次成功合成了重Sr掺杂的双层Ruddlesden-Popper镍氧化物La₂SrNi₂O₇₋δ，该材料在环境压力下呈现四方结构（I4/mmm）和180°的Ni-O-Ni键角，且无密度波序，但无论加压或改变氧含量均不出现超导。理论计算揭示Sr掺杂的空穴主要进入Ni-3d_z²轨道，使该能带严重偏离半填充态，破坏了层间反铁磁相互作用，从而抑制了超导配对。
AI.motivation: 双层RP镍氧化物的高温超导已在高压或压应变薄膜中被发现，但超导态通常伴随四方结构和密度波抑制，尚不清楚这些条件是否足以在环境压力下实现超导。本文旨在通过化学掺杂（Sr掺杂）替代外部压力或应变，探究在环境压力下实现超导的可能条件及限制因素。
AI.method: 采用高压高温（HPHT）条件下的助熔剂法首次合成重Sr掺杂的La₂SrNi₂O₇₋δ样品；利用X射线衍射和扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）表征晶体结构；通过电阻测量表征输运性质；并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算分析电子结构（能带、费米面、轨道占据）以解释实验现象。
AI.result: 成功合成了具有四方（I4/mmm）结构、c轴180° Ni-O-Ni键角的重Sr掺杂镍氧化物样品。电阻测量显示金属行为伴随低温上翘，且无密度波特征。然而，无论施加压力还是改变氧含量均未诱导出超导。DFT计算表明Sr掺杂的空穴主要进入Ni-3d_z²轨道，形成很大的γ费米面口袋，显著降低该轨道占据数，使其严重偏离半填充态。
AI.conclusion: 虽然四方结构和密度波抑制在超导态中常见，但这些因素并非在环境压力下实现超导的充分条件。Ni-3d_z²能带的半填充态对于层间反铁磁耦合及超导配对至关重要；Sr掺杂导致该能带严重偏离半填充，破坏了配对机制，因而无法实现超导。这一发现揭示了在双层镍酸盐体系中实现超导的关键物理要求。

title: Floquet scattering and Fano resonances in nodal-ring and multi-Weyl semimetals: Role of propagating and evanescent modes
summary: We develop a comprehensive Floquet scattering theory for quantum transport in periodically driven nodal-ring semimetals (NRSs) and multi-Weyl semimetals (mWSMs), extending our earlier study reported in Annalen der Physik 535, 2200460 (2023), in which evanescent modes were neglected, to a complete formalism that includes both propagating and evanescent channels. By solving the full boundary-value problem, we obtain the complete set of scattering states and show that, although evanescent modes are indispensable for satisfying the matching conditions at the potential interfaces, they carry zero net probability current and do not contribute to any observable transport quantity. We identify a previously unexplored transport regime in NRSs in which two propagating channels coexist and participate in coherent scattering, producing multi-channel quantum interference and Floquet-induced Fano resonances. The transmission, reflection, pumped shot noise, and the associated Fano resonance features are determined entirely by the propagating channels, and the resonance energies coincide with those of the corresponding quasi-bound states of the static potential well. Our results establish a unified framework for Floquet transport in anisotropic topological semimetals, and confirm that the approximation of neglecting evanescent modes in our earlier work is justified for all measurable transport properties.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了周期性驱动节环半金属(NRSs)和多外尔半金属(mWSMs)中量子输运的完整Floquet散射理论，将之前忽略衰逝模的研究扩展为包含传播模和衰逝模的完整形式体系。通过求解完整边值问题，证明衰逝模虽对满足匹配条件不可或缺，但不贡献净概率流和不影响任何可观测输运量。研究发现了NRSs中一个新的双传播通道相干散射输运区域，产生多通道量子干涉和Floquet诱导的Fano共振。
AI.motivation: 作者之前的研究(Ann. Phys. 535, 2200460, 2023)忽略了衰逝模，需要验证这种近似的合理性，并建立更完整的形式体系。同时，周期性驱动下各向异性拓扑半金属中的量子输运机制尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 发展了完整的Floquet散射理论，包含传播模和衰逝模两种通道；通过求解完整边界值问题获得全部散射态；分析势界面处的匹配条件；计算透射、反射、泵浦散粒噪声及Fano共振特征。
AI.result: 衰逝模虽为匹配界面条件所必需，但其净概率流为零，不贡献任何可观测输运量。在NRSs中发现此前未探索的双传播通道共存并参与相干散射的输运区域，产生多通道量子干涉和Floquet诱导的Fano共振。共振能量与静态势阱中准束缚态能量一致，输运特性完全由传播通道决定。
AI.conclusion: 建立了各向异性拓扑半金属中Floquet输运的统一框架，并证实之前工作中忽略衰逝模的近似对所有可测输运性质都是合理的。

title: Optical-Phonon-Enabled Large Lattice Thermal Conductivity Anisotropy in Hexagonal Perovskites Cs$BX_3$ ($B$ = Mg, Cd; $X$ = Cl, Br, I)
summary: Materials exhibiting strongly anisotropic lattice thermal conductivity are desirable for thermal-management applications, yet such behavior is commonly associated with layered or quasi-one-dimensional van der Waals crystals and highly anisotropic elastic properties. Here, we investigate lattice thermal transport in the hexagonal perovskites Cs$BX_3$ ($B=$ Mg, Cd; $X=$ Cl, Br, I) using first-principles calculations. At 300~K, the calculated in-plane and out-of-plane lattice thermal conductivities range from 0.13--0.83 and 0.34--6.26~Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$, respectively, corresponding to anisotropy ratios of 2.6--7.5. This pronounced anisotropy is remarkable given the relatively modest elastic anisotropy, characterized by $C_{33}/C_{11}$ = 0.994--1.842. Our analysis reveals that medium-frequency optical phonons provide an efficient out-of-plane heat-transport channel, contrary to the conventional picture in which heat transport is dominated by acoustic phonons. These findings identify face-sharing octahedral frameworks as a promising platform for engineering strong thermal-conductivity anisotropy in mechanically near-isotropic, non--van der Waals crystals.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了六方钙钛矿CsBX₃（B=Mg, Cd；X=Cl, Br, I）的晶格热输运性质，发现其面内与面外热导率各向异性比高达2.6–7.5，尽管其力学各向异性相对较弱（C₃₃/C₁₁=0.994–1.842）。研究发现中频光学声子提供了高效的面外热输运通道，推翻了传统上热输运由声学声子主导的观念，指出面共享八面体框架是工程化强热导各向异性的有前景平台。
AI.motivation: 现有强各向异性热导率材料通常依赖于层状或准一维范德华晶体及高度各向异性的弹性性质，这限制了材料选择范围。作者希望探索在力学近各向同性、非范德华晶体中实现强热导各向异性的可能性，以拓展热管理材料的应用前景。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（DFT），对六方钙钛矿CsBX₃（B=Mg, Cd；X=Cl, Br, I）系列材料进行晶格热输运模拟，计算300K下的面内与面外晶格热导率，分析各向异性比、弹性性质（C₃₃/C₁₁）及声子模式对热输运的贡献。
AI.result: 300K时面内热导率为0.13–0.83 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹，面外热导率为0.34–6.26 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹，各向异性比达2.6–7.5；弹性各向异性C₃₃/C₁₁仅为0.994–1.842，力学接近各向同性。中频光学声子是面外热输运的主要通道，而非传统认为的声学声子主导。
AI.conclusion: 面共享八面体框架结构能够在力学近各向同性的非范德华晶体中实现强热导各向异性，打破了对传统层状/范德华材料的依赖，为设计各向异性热管理材料提供了新的结构平台和设计思路。

title: Correlation-Driven Nonlinear Magnetoelectric Response in an Altermagnet: A Dynamical Mean-Field Study
summary: We investigate the optical nonlinear magnetoelectric effect (NMEE) in a strongly correlated altermagnet using dynamical mean-field theory. Unlike effective band descriptions with an imposed spin splitting, our approach determines the altermagnetic order, electronic spectrum, and optical nonlinear response self-consistently. We find that the NMEE is finite in the altermagnetic phase and vanishes in the paramagnetic phase. Its frequency dependence reflects the spin-resolved spectral structure and provides an estimate of the characteristic altermagnetic spin-splitting scale. Interaction and temperature tuning produce qualitatively different behavior: at low temperature, reducing the interaction strength toward the interaction-driven magnetic phase boundary enhances the response, whereas increasing the temperature suppresses it and drives it to zero above the critical temperature. These results establish the optical NMEE as a probe of correlated altermagnetic order and suggest that tuning parameters such as pressure, strain, or chemical substitution toward an interaction-driven phase boundary may provide a promising route to maximizing the response.

AI.tldr: 本文利用动力学平均场理论研究了强关联交错磁体（altermagnet）中的光学非线性磁电效应（NMEE），发现该效应在交错磁相中有限、在顺磁相中消失，其频率依赖可估算交错磁自旋劈裂尺度，且相互作用与温度的调控产生定性不同的响应行为。
AI.motivation: 以往对交错磁体中非线性磁电效应的研究多采用有效能带描述并外加自旋劈裂，未能自洽处理强关联效应。作者希望从微观关联理论出发，自洽地刻画交错磁有序、电子谱与光学非线性响应之间的关系，从而为探测强关联交错磁序提供可靠的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用动力学平均场理论（DMFT）对强关联交错磁体进行研究，自洽地确定交错磁有序、电子光谱以及光学非线性响应，无需人为施加自旋劈裂，能完整反映关联效应对磁电响应的影响。
AI.result: NMEE在交错磁相中为有限值而在顺磁相中消失；其频率依赖反映了自旋分辨的谱结构并可用于估算特征自旋劈裂尺度；低温和相互作用调控显示：低温下降低相互作用强度（趋近磁相边界）可增强响应，而升温则抑制响应并在临界温度以上归零。
AI.conclusion: 光学NMEE可作为一种探测强关联交错磁序的有效手段，通过调节压力、应变或化学掺杂等参数趋近相互作用驱动的磁相边界，可能为最大化该响应提供有希望的途径。

title: A Human-AI Theorem Connecting Spontaneous and Field-Induced Mechanisms of Collective Behavior in One Dimension
summary: Can an artificial intelligence (AI) generate a scientific hypothesis outside a human collaborator's active hypothesis space (AHS), and can human-AI research be organized to make such breakthroughs more likely? We document such a case while proving a theorem that connects two basic organizing mechanisms of statistical physics: collective behavior arising in zero field from competing interactions and that induced or controlled by an external field. A zero-field $O(n)$-vector open chain with arbitrary inhomogeneous nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor interaction functions $U_i(S_i\cdot{S}_{i+1})$ and $V_i(S_i\cdot{S}_{i+2})$ is microscopically, via a temperature-independent mapping at the Hamiltonian level, equivalent to a simpler $O(n)$ open chain with nearest-neighbor interaction $V_i( σ_i\cdot σ_{i+1})$ and axial single-spin potential $U_i(σ_i^z)$ for every integer $n\ge1$ and every system size $L\ge1$. The homogeneous linear specialization maps the foundational frustrated $J_1$-$J_2$ model onto the canonical $J$-$h$ field model---with $n=1,2,3$ being the Ising, XY, and Heisenberg classical spin models, respectively. An analogous theorem holds when the continuous $O(n)$ spins are replaced by the $q$-state Potts spins with the standard Potts interaction, implying a closed-form exact solution of the $J_1$-$J_2$ Potts open chain for every $q\ge2$ and every $L\ge1$. The emergence of the theorems from sustained human-AI collaboration suggests that involving AI throughout a systematic research program may incubate autonomous scientific breakthroughs.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了一个人工智能（AI）在人类合作者的主动假设空间（AHS）之外生成科学假设的案例。研究者通过持续的人机协作证明了一个连接统计物理学两种基本组织机制（零场下竞争相互作用产生的集体行为与外部场诱导/控制的集体行为）的定理：零场O(n)向量开放链在微观层面（通过与温度无关的哈密顿量级映射）等价于具有最近邻相互作用和轴向单自旋势的简单O(n)开放链；该定理对Potts自旋系统同样成立，从而给出了J1-J2 Potts开放链的闭式精确解。这一结果暗示，将AI系统性地融入研究过程可能孵化自主的科学突破。
AI.motivation: 本研究希望探究两个核心问题：(1) AI能否在人类合作者的主动假设空间之外自主生成科学假设（即人类尚未想到的突破性方向）？(2) 人机协作研究的组织方式能否使这类突破更可能发生？论文记载了这类罕见的突破性案例，为回答上述问题提供了实证。
AI.method: 论文证明了一个一般性定理：任意非均匀的零场O(n)向量开放链（包含最近邻相互作用Ui(Si·S{i+1})和次近邻相互作用Vi(Si·S{i+2})）可通过与温度无关的哈密顿量级映射，等价于具有最近邻相互作用Vi(σi·σ{i+1})和轴向单自旋势Ui(σi^z)的简单O(n)开放链，适用于所有整数n≥1和系统尺寸L≥1。该同质线性特化将著名的受挫J1-J2模型映射到经典的J-h场模型。类似的定理对q态Potts自旋系统也成立，由此导出J1-J2 Potts开放链对所有q≥2和L≥1的闭式精确解。
AI.result: 研究成功证明了连接零场竞争相互作用系统与外部场诱导系统的严格映射定理，统一了两类统计物理的组织机制。具体包括：O(n)自旋情况的一般性等价定理（覆盖Ising/XY/Heisenberg模型及其J1-J2特化）和q态Potts情况的对应定理（提供精确解）。更重要的是，这些定理源自持续的人机协作过程，实证了AI能够在人类假设空间之外生成有效的科学假设。
AI.conclusion: 该研究在物理层面建立了从受挫系统（J1-J2模型）到场诱导系统（J-h模型）的严格等价性，深化了对集体行为组织机制的理解；在AI与科学发现层面，此案例表明将AI全程纳入系统性研究程序可以孵化那些超出人类主动假设空间的自主科学突破，为人机协作科研的组织范式提供了重要启示。

title: Expanding the trilayer Ruddlesden-Popper nickelate family: Synthesis and characterization of Sm$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10-δ}$ single crystals
summary: The discovery of high-temperature superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates has attracted significant attention. Bulk superconductivity emerges under pressure in trilayer nickelates La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10-δ}$ (T$_c$ $\approx$ 30 K) and Pr$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10-δ}$ (T$_c$ $\approx$ 40.5 K), where the reduced ionic radius of Pr$^{3+}$ may generate internal chemical pressure and enhance T$_c$. However, synthesizing trilayer RP phases with smaller rare-earth elements (Ln) is extremely challenging. So far, only the La, Pr, and Nd analogues have been synthesized with stable phases in the single rare-earth form. Here we report the first successful high-pressure and high-temperature (HPHT) synthesis of samarium-based compound Sm$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10-δ}$. Magnetization and transport measurements consistently confirm a density wave (DW) transition at ~180 K at ambient pressure. Through a careful fitting to the structural data of Sm$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10-δ}$, it is found that the bond angle of (Ni-O-Ni) associating with the interlayer apical oxygen is much smaller than 180$^{\circ}$, which was assumed to be the key factor for the occurrence of superconductivity. By applying pressures up to 80 GPa, despite partial suppression of insulating behavior and the DW order, but superconductivity is not observed in our present study. Density functional theory calculations suggest that the 3d$_{z^2}$ and 3d$_{x^2-y^2}$ are separated from other t$_{2g}$ orbitals and make a primary contribution to the Fermi surface. The newly synthesized trilayer nickelate Sm$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10-δ}$ offers a unique platform for probing the fundamental physics of RP nickelates.

AI.tldr: 本文首次成功合成了基于钐(Sm)的三层Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐Sm₄Ni₃O₁₀₋δ，在环境压力下观察到~180 K的密度波转变，加压至80 GPa虽部分抑制绝缘行为和密度波有序但未观察到超导，DFT计算表明3d_z²和3d_x²⁻y²轨道对费米面起主要贡献。
AI.motivation: 三层RP镍酸盐（如La₄Ni₃O₁₀₋δ和Pr₄Ni₃O₁₀₋δ）在压力下表现出高温超导，且较小的稀土离子半径可能通过内部化学压力增强T_c。然而合成含有更小稀土元素的稳定三层RP相极为困难，目前仅成功合成了La、Pr和Nd类似物。因此探索更小离子半径稀土元素（如Sm）的三层镍酸盐合成对理解超导机理和寻找更高T_c材料具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用高压高温(HPHT)方法首次合成Sm₄Ni₃O₁₀₋δ；通过磁化率和输运测量表征其物理性质；对结构数据进行精细拟合分析(Ni-O-Ni)键角；施加高达80 GPa的压力研究超导性；结合密度泛函理论(DFT)计算分析电子结构。
AI.result: 成功合成Sm₄Ni₃O₁₀₋δ，在环境压力下检测到~180 K的密度波转变；结构分析发现与层间顶端氧相关的(Ni-O-Ni)键角远小于180°（这被认为是超导发生的关键因素）；尽管加压至80 GPa部分抑制了绝缘行为和密度波有序，但未观察到超导；DFT计算表明3d_z²和3d_x²⁻y²轨道与其他t₂g轨道分离并对费米面起主要贡献。
AI.conclusion: 新合成的三层镍酸盐Sm₄Ni₃O₁₀₋δ为研究RP镍酸盐的基础物理提供了独特平台，其小稀土离子导致的显著键角畸变可能是抑制超导的关键因素，加深了对小离子半径稀土对三层RP镍酸盐结构与超导性影响的理解。

title: Narrow-Sense Type-III Dirac Cones and Additional Flat Lines on a Honeycomb Lattice with Anisotropic Next-Nearest-Neighbor Hoppings
comment: 12 pages, 23 figures, The Supplemental Material is included as an Appendix
summary:
Critically tilted Dirac cones have attracted considerable attention because of their unconventional electronic properties in two-dimensional massless Dirac-fermion systems. Among them, the narrow-sense type-III Dirac cone is characterized by a flat dispersion along the direction connecting the two Dirac points.
  Using a tight-binding model on a single-orbital honeycomb lattice, we demonstrate that narrow-sense type-III Dirac cones can be realized by tuning anisotropic next-nearest-neighbor hoppings. Type-I and type-II Dirac cones emerge on either side of the critical point, enabling a systematic investigation of the electronic properties across the type-I, narrow-sense type-III, and type-II regimes.
  We further find that the present model exhibits additional flat lines in momentum space whose energy coincides with the Dirac-point energy at the narrow-sense type-III critical point. This band structure produces a pronounced enhancement of the density of states at the Fermi energy and, consequently, a substantial enhancement of the electronic specific heat compared with that expected for an ideal narrow-sense type-III Dirac cone. Our results show that the honeycomb lattice with anisotropic next-nearest-neighbor hoppings provides a simple platform for exploring unconventional thermodynamic properties arising from the energy coincidence of narrow-sense type-III Dirac cones and additional flat lines at the Fermi energy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过单轨道蜂窝晶格紧束缚模型证明，通过调节各向异性的次近邻跳跃可以精确实现窄义III型狄拉克锥（沿连接两个狄拉克点方向具有平带色散），并发现该临界点处额外平线与狄拉克点能量重合，显著增强了费米能级处的态密度和电子比热。
AI.motivation: 临界倾斜狄拉克锥（如窄义III型狄拉克锥）具有非常规电子性质，但在二维无质量狄拉克费米子系统中实现和系统研究此类体系的平台仍然匮乏，需要寻找简单可行的实现方案以探索其独特的热力学性质。
AI.method: 采用单轨道蜂窝晶格上的紧束缚模型，通过调节各向异性次近邻跳跃参数来调控狄拉克锥的倾斜程度，实现并研究I型、窄义III型和II型狄拉克锥区域的转变及相应的能带与态密度特性。
AI.result: （1）通过调节各向异性次近邻跳跃可实现窄义III型狄拉克锥，I型和II型分别出现在临界点两侧；（2）在窄义III型临界点处，模型中额外出现能量与狄拉克点能量重合的动量空间平带；（3）该能带结构导致费米能级态密度显著增强，电子比热相比理想窄义III型狄拉克锥大幅提高。
AI.conclusion: 各向异性次近邻跳跃的蜂窝晶格为探索窄义III型狄拉克锥与额外平带在费米能级能量重合所引发的非常规热力学性质提供了一个简单而有效的平台。

title: Fourier Neural Operators for Composition-Driven Crystal Structure Discovery
summary: Crystalline materials discovery is essential for energy, electronics, and catalysis, but the vast chemical and structural space makes exhaustive screening infeasible. Existing voxel-based methods are limited by the local receptive fields of three-dimensional convolutional neural networks and the posterior collapse of high-dimensional variational autoencoders. Here, we develop a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO)-based crystal-field solver that maps a prescribed chemical formula and lattice parameters to periodic number-density and electron-density fields. By operating on global Fourier modes, the solver captures long-range correlations in periodic crystal fields beyond conventional local convolutions. Building on this solver, we construct a coupled generation-solving framework in which a conditional variational autoencoder generates diverse candidate lattice parameters in a low-dimensional basis-coefficient space, followed by density-field prediction and atomic reconstruction through peak detection, position optimization, and weight optimization. The reconstructed structures are further screened using voxel-level filtering, machine-learning interatomic-potential relaxation, and first-principle calculations. The framework generates novel structures across 104 chemical formulas with competitive reconstruction accuracy, demonstrating high generative diversity and structural validity. By extending Fourier neural operators to periodic crystal fields and coupling them with composition-conditioned lattice generation, our approach provides a scalable route to crystal structure discovery from prescribed chemical compositions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于傅里叶神经算子（FNO）的晶体场求解器，将化学式与晶格参数映射为周期性的数密度和电子密度场。该求解器通过全局傅里叶模态捕捉周期性晶体场中的长程关联，突破了传统三维卷积神经网络的局部感受野限制。在此基础上构建了生成-求解耦合框架：条件变分自编码器在低维基系数空间中生成候选晶格参数，随后通过密度场预测、峰值检测、位置与权重优化实现原子重建，并经过体素级过滤、机器学习原子间势弛豫和第一性原理计算筛选。该框架在104种化学式上生成了具有竞争力的重建精度和高度生成多样性的新颖结构。
AI.motivation: 晶体材料在能源、电子和催化领域至关重要，但其巨大的化学和结构空间使得穷举筛选不可行。现有基于体素的方法受限于三维卷积神经网络的局部感受野以及高维变分自编码器的后验坍缩问题，无法有效捕捉晶体结构中的长程关联信息，因此需要一种能够处理周期性晶体场全局信息的新方法。
AI.method: 作者开发了一种基于FNO的晶体场求解器，利用全局傅里叶模态来映射化学式和晶格参数到周期性的数密度/电子密度场，从而捕捉长程相关性。整体框架采用耦合生成-求解策略：(1)条件变分自编码器在低维基系数空间中生成多样化的候选晶格参数；(2)密度场预测后进行原子重建（峰值检测、位置优化、权重优化）；(3)通过体素级过滤、机器学习原子间势弛豫和第一性原理计算进行筛选验证。
AI.result: 该框架在104种化学式上成功生成了新颖的晶体结构，实现了具有竞争力的重建精度，并表现出高度的生成多样性和结构有效性，证明了FNO扩展到周期性晶体场并结合成分条件化晶格生成的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 将傅里叶神经算子扩展到周期性晶体场，并与成分条件化的晶格生成相耦合，为从指定化学成分出发的晶体结构发现提供了一条可扩展的路径，克服了传统体素方法在长程关联建模和生成多样性方面的局限。

title: Lead-free piezoelectric perovskites for arterial-pulse e-skin: from configurational complexity to equivariant machine-learning potentials
summary: Continuous, non-invasive monitoring of the arterial pulse is a clinical priority for cardiovascular disease, the leading cause of global mortality. Flexible piezoelectric electronic skins can transduce the 1-10 kPa pressure wave into a self-powered voltage, but the best-performing piezoceramics are lead-based, and their toxicity is incompatible with skin contact and with tightening RoHS/REACH regulation. Among lead-free alternatives, the BaTiO$3$-based solid solution BZT-BCT reaches $d{33} \approx 620$ pC/N near its tricritical morphotropic phase boundary, rivalling soft PZT while remaining biocompatible. Exploiting this in a wearable confronts a sensitivity-flexibility paradox and three computational walls: the combinatorial explosion of atomic configurations in a disordered solid solution, the band-gap error of affordable density-functional approximations, which corrupts leakage and insulation estimates, and the 0 K nature of standard calculations against a 310 K operating temperature. We review lead-free piezoelectrics, morphotropic-boundary physics and fabricated flexible devices, then argue that equivariant machine-learning interatomic potentials --- coupled to a tiered functional hierarchy and finite-temperature lattice dynamics --- can survey the full configurational ensemble at body temperature and close the gap to a clinically viable lead-free pulse sensor.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了用于连续无创动脉脉搏监测的无铅柔性压电电子皮肤。重点围绕BZT-BCT这种铅基之外性能最优(约620 pC/N)的生物相容压电固溶体，指出其实际应用于可穿戴领域面临灵敏度-柔性悖论，以及原子构型组合爆炸、带隙误差、0K与310K工作温度差异三大计算瓶颈，进而提出以等变机器学习原子间势结合层叠泛函层级与有限温度晶格动力学，可在体温下遍历全部构型系综，助力实现临床可行的无铅脉搏传感器。
AI.motivation: 心血管疾病是全球首要死因，动脉脉搏的连续非侵入监测具有重要临床价值。但现有最优压电材料为含铅陶瓷（如PZT），其毒性不适用于皮肤接触且受RoHS/REACH法规限制，因此亟需高性能、生物相容且计算上可解析的无铅替代方案来推动实用化脉搏传感设备。
AI.method: 本文为综述性论证：先回顾无铅压电材料、准同型相界物理与柔性器件制造，随后提出应对三大计算瓶颈（构型爆炸、带隙失真、环境温度缺失）的策略——采用等变机器学习原子间势，配以层叠泛函层级和有限温度晶格动力学，从而在310K体温条件下完整模拟无序固溶体的构型系综并预测器件性能。
AI.result: 识别出BZT-BCT在准同型相界附近约620 pC/N的优异压电系数，可与软PZT媲美且保持生物相容；清晰界定了将其用于柔性可穿戴器件时的"灵敏度-柔性"悖论及三大计算挑战，并提出机器学习势驱动的多尺度计算框架作为填补理论与临床器件之间鸿沟的可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 结论认为，通过等变机器学习原子间势、层级泛函与有限温度动力学相结合的计算方法论，有望系统扫描无铅压电固溶体在体温下的全部构型空间，为设计与验证临床可行的无铅柔性脉搏传感器铺平道路，兼顾法规合规性与监护性能。

title: Self-Healing Diffusion Monte Carlo applied to a simple fermionic model: A critical assessment of the method
summary: We investigate the Self-Healing Diffusion Monte Carlo (SHDMC) method using a one-dimensional model with periodic boundary conditions. An inversion symmetry is introduced to mimic the antisymmetry property of fermionic wavefunctions, with the bosonic and fermionic sectors being modeled by the even and odd eigenstates, respectively.
